We measure results, not hours, and offer paid time off. Development Opportunities:
As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path. Team Gatherings:
Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun. We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone. Wellness Fund:
€1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.
Move Up Media
We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of i Gaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords. With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Reiseberater:in brasilien (freelance, vor ort)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Reiseberater:in brasilien (freelance, vor ort) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Travel Buddies Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen.
Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür.
Was du machst Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns:
Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus.
Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per Whats App, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst.
Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden.
Was du mitbringen musst Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen. Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch. Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich. Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per Whats App und im Video-Call.
Was zusätzlich hilft Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse Englisch fließend Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, Whats App Business Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im Amazonas
Was wir bieten Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt. Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen. Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen. Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst. Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.

Nesta posição, você será responsável por gerenciar solicitações de viagens de alta complexidade, garantindo qualidade, eficiência operacional e cumprimento dos processos e SLAs estabelecidos. Além disso, terá papel ativo na identificação de melhorias, desenvolvimento de colaboradores, condução de treinamentos e implementação de práticas inovadoras que agreguem valor aos clientes e ao negócio! Requisitos: Formação técnica e/ou superior em Turismo, Hotelaria, Administração ou áreas equivalentes; Inglês avançado/fluente; Conhecimento em Pacote Office; Experiência com viagens corporativas; Conhecimento avançado dos sistemas OBT e GDS; Conhecimento avançado dos sistemas de locadoras e cias aéreas; Conhecimento avançado dos players de hospedagem. Atividades: Efetuar atendimento às solicitações de viagens corporativas nacionais/internacionais, agregando máxima qualidade e eficiência operacional, respeitando SLA, cumprindo com os processos obrigatórios e particularidades para fidelizar nossos clientes e elevar continuamente a qualidade da nossa entrega; Identificar, analisar e reagir a possibilidades de melhorias processuais para clientes internos e externos; Realizar cotação, reserva, emissão e reemissão de aéreo nacional/Internacional - Hotel nacional/Internacional - Local nacional/Internacional - rodoviário nacional / seguro viagens / grupos aéreos, hotéis e passeios nacionais/Internacionais; Ministrar treinamentos; Desenvolver colaboradores; Tratativa de processos junto a clientes e demais analistas; Atuar junto à gerência no desenvolvimento e implementação de novos processos e procedimentos, incentivando formas inovadoras de entregar mais valor aos clientes e ao negócio. title: Accounting analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. As an Accounting Analyst, you’ll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You’ll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our finance and operations departments.
You’ll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of our financial records, preparing key financial statements, and supporting the business with timely and data-driven reporting. This role requires a proactive approach, a strong grasp of Brazilian tax regulations, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment.
Specifically, your role will involve:
Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws (SPED, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, etc.). Prepare and analyze financial statements (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial, Fluxo de Caixa). Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations. Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures. Prepare and analyze the company’s accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency. Develop accounting reports to support decision-making.
The ideal profile
We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside Move Up Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:
Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English. Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS). Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings. Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil. Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting. Are proficient in accounting software — knowledge of Odoo is a plus. Excel in advanced Excel skills and familiarity with financial analysis tools. Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments. Focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering reliable financial information. Show active listening, resilience, and persistence. Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination. Excel in time management, organization, and planning. Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously. Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making. Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.
Next steps in the process ✅
First Interview:
A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements. Second Interview:
A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with Move Up Media. Third Interview:
A conversation with our CFO to align on technical expectations and ensure you're the right fit for our finance team. Final Step:
A proposition for us to start working together!
What’s in it for you
Remote Work Environment:
Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time. Flexible Schedule:
We measure results, not hours, and offer paid time off. Development Opportunities:
As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path. Team Gatherings:
Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun. We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone. Wellness Fund:
€1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.
Move Up Media
We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of i Gaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords. With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!
Here at Move Up Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! description:

JOB DESCRIPTION Their day to day includes accurately labeling machine learning textual data to refine AI models. Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate within a multi-disciplinary team. Quick learner and self-starter with strong problem-solving skills.

title: Voice over artist (brazilian portuguese)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Voice over artist (brazilian portuguese) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. TDLR : Pocket FM is hiring remote freelance Brazilian Portuguese Voice Over Artists with professional home studios for long-term, serialized audio fiction. The role requires native fluency and the capacity to deliver 20 to 40 hours of recorded content monthly on a per-hour paid basis.
Voice Over Artist (Brazilian Portuguese)
About Pocket FM
Pocket FM is the world’s leading audio storytelling platform, reaching over 200 million listeners across more than 20 countries. We combine human creativity and innovative technology to create immersive audio series enjoyed by millions of listeners worldwide.
As we expand our Portuguese content library, we are looking for talented, professional
Brazilian Voice Over Artists
to join our global network of creators.
Role Overview
As a Freelance Voice Over Artist, you will bring complex characters and gripping stories to life in serialized audio fiction. You will collaborate remotely with our production, writing, and quality teams to deliver highly engaging, emotionally authentic performances for long-form series.
This is a remote, contract-based freelance opportunity offering a consistent monthly pipeline of work for a long-term collaboration.
Requirements
Native Fluency: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with the ability to perform in Neutral Brazilian Portuguese. Versatility & Acting Chops: Strong acting, dubbing, or storytelling skills, with the ability to portray diverse characters across a wide range of ages and emotional profiles. Proven Experience: Background in voice acting, dubbing, audiobook narration, audio drama, or podcasting. Studio Setup: A professional home recording studio environment with a high-quality microphone and reliable, high-speed internet. Capacity: Availability to record and deliver up to 20-40 hours of recorded content per month, while maintaining weekly delivery schedules. Collaboration: Openness to taking performance direction and participating in necessary retakes/feedback sessions.
Nice to Have Familiarity with basic audio editing and file management Experience working remotely with production teams
Engagement Details Contract Type:
Freelance / Independent Contractor Location:
Remote (Work from your own studio) Compensation:
Paid monthly on an hours delivered basis. How to Apply :
Please fill in
UJ9 MNZCs92n U8
What happens after you apply?
Our Casting & Production Process : Here is a look at our step-by-step collaboration pipeline: 1. Internal Evaluation: Our production team will carefully review your voice demos, studio specs, and portfolio to see if your vocal profile matches our upcoming projects. 2. Show Casting & Voice Testing: If your profile fits, we will invite you to a voice test for the specific audio series we are casting. This helps us ensure your performance aligns perfectly with the character's vision. 3. Contract & Legal Alignment: Once selected for a show, we will finalize a freelance legal agreement. This contract will clearly outline the voice usage rights for the series and formalize our agreed monthly payment terms. 4. Calibration & Onboarding: Before the official recording begins, we will run a brief calibration session. This ensures your studio's audio mastering levels match our technical delivery standards for a seamless workflow. 5. Production & Monthly Deliveries: Recording begins! Our long-form audio series typically span
150 to 300 hours
in total. We partner with you for the long haul, expecting a steady delivery of
20 to 40 hours of recorded content per month

title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Qc analyst - audio content - brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Us
Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.
At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.
Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.
Role Overview
As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.
Key Responsibilities
1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.
2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.
3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble
4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.
Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.
5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.
6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.
7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.
8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology
9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately
80 hours of audio content
within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.
10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery
Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.
Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.
Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.
Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.
Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English
This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

title: Data entry specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data entry specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.
Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance. Company Overview Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes. Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you'll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect. Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply. What You'll Do Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements; Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution; Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld; Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity. Who You Are A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration. Available 40 hours per week during U. S. business hours (EST). Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets. Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly. Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up. Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight. Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus. Why Join Jones Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class Saa S growth month-over-month. Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses; Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth. Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment. Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team's mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Strategic customer success manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategic customer success manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Client
Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (An Paa S) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.
With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.
The Role
As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.
You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.
Why Join Our Customer Success Team
This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).
You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.
About You
- You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. - You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success. - You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. - You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. - You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.
Requirements
- 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (Saa S/BI/analytics preferred). - Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion. - Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. - Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. - Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. - Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. - Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. - Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). - Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. - Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities. - Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/Gen AI enablement, or similar technical solutions.
How You'll Ramp
By Day 30
- Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). - Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.
By Day 60
- Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). - Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. - Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.
By Day 90
- Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). - Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. - Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.
Join Client!
Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. As an Accounting Analyst, you’ll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You’ll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our finance and operations departments.
You’ll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of our financial records, preparing key financial statements, and supporting the business with timely and data-driven reporting. This role requires a proactive approach, a strong grasp of Brazilian tax regulations, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment.
Specifically, your role will involve:
Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws (SPED, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, etc.). Prepare and analyze financial statements (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial, Fluxo de Caixa). Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations. Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures. Prepare and analyze the company’s accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency. Develop accounting reports to support decision-making.
The ideal profile
We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside Move Up Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:
Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English. Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS). Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings. Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil. Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting. Are proficient in accounting software — knowledge of Odoo is a plus. Excel in advanced Excel skills and familiarity with financial analysis tools. Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments. Focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering reliable financial information. Show active listening, resilience, and persistence. Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination. Excel in time management, organization, and planning. Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously. Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making. Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.
Next steps in the process ✅
First Interview:
A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements. Second Interview:
A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with Move Up Media. Third Interview:
A conversation with our CFO to align on technical expectations and ensure you're the right fit for our finance team. Final Step:
A proposition for us to start working together!
What’s in it for you
Remote Work Environment:
Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time. Flexible Schedule:
We measure results, not hours, and offer paid time off. Development Opportunities:
As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path. Team Gatherings:
Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun. We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone. Wellness Fund:
€1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.
Move Up Media
We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of i Gaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords. With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!

Le as issues (Jira), identifica issues prontas pra cada stage, dispara agentes (Claude/Open IA/Gemini/Deep Seek) com contexto rico, valida o resultado, posta comentario na issue, e avanca o status. Roda em servidores Linux, com auto-update. •
Agentes (@dev,@qa,@sec,@devops,@pm,@po,@sm,@analyst,@architect,@data-engineer,@ux-design-expert):
cada um com persona, authority matrix
definida, skills executáveis e Gates de qualidade. •
Rules:
Mais de 60 regras formais que governam o comportamento dos agentes — desde naming conventions até anti-hallucination validation em 7 camadas. Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent. •
Recovery loops:
quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota. •
Multi-repo via submodules:
projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar. •
Stack:
Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.js/Type Script (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq, integrações HTTP com Jira/Git Hub via curl + retry policy.
O que você vai fazer
Manutenção do core (40%) • Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade ciclomática. • Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário. • Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento. • Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue). • Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta \"agent crashou em loop\", \"PR criado no repo errado\", \"deploy não promoveu\") e fechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva.
Evolução de agents e rules (35%) • Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist). • Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho. • Manter o agent-authority.md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex:@dev ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146). • Criar/refatorar skills. • Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B).
Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%) • Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, Open AI CLI, Gemini CLI, Deep Seek direct). • Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex: Deep Seek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação). • Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve. • Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient; expandir cobertura). • Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection — entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria.
O que esperamos de você
Stack técnica — obrigatório •
Bash/Shell avançado e Linux
— você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs, parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de (( e porque importa. •
Node.js / Type Script
— escreve TS com strict mode, entende quando
não
usar Node (ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS). •
Git e Git Hub avançado
— cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, Git Hub Actions workflows. •
Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos
— você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que \"diga ao modelo o que
não
fazer\" raramente funciona, entende o efeito de exemplos few-shot vs zero-shot, e já debugou ao menos uma vez porque um agente está \"alucinando\" um PR que não criou.
Experiência • 5+ anos de engenharia de software produzindo sistemas em produção. • Pelo menos 1 ano com
agentes autônomos / orquestração de LLMs
em ambiente real (não bootcamp, não side project) — você sabe a diferença entre \"rodou no demo\" e \"rodou em prod 24/7 sem humano\". • Histórico comprovado de manter sistemas legados com debt técnico — você não quer \"reescrever do zero\". • Inglês técnico fluente para leitura/escrita (documentação, issues, comentários de código em inglês obrigatórios; comunicação verbal pode ser PT/EN/ZH dependendo do time).
Mentalidade •
Determinismo > magia.
Você prefere uma regex feia em bash que sempre funciona a um ML model elegante que falha em 5% dos casos. Em orquestração de agentes, 5% de falha = produto inviável. •
Forensics sobre intuição.
Antes de propor solução, você lê o log, o diff, a issue real do cliente. Não inventa hipótese. •
Documentação executável.
Quando você cria uma rule nova, ela tem detector regex que pode rodar em CI. \"Documentei em texto\" não basta. •
Empatia por agente.
Você consegue ler um prompt de 8k tokens e identificar onde o modelo vai se confundir, por que, e o que ajustar.
Diferenciais • Experiencia com Claude Agent SDK, Open AI Agents SDK, Lang Graph ou frameworks de orquestração equivalentes. • Já implementou ou manteve sistemas de
retry policy + backoff exponencial + circuit breaker
em integrações com APIs externas instáveis. • Já trabalhou com
monorepos via submodules
(nao apenas Nx/Turborepo) e entende os trade-offs. • Contribuições open-source em projetos relacionados (CLIs, dev tooling, agent frameworks). • Experiencia com
Dev Ops em servidores Linux dedicados
(não apenas k8s/cloud managed): systemd, cron, logrotate, monitoring com ferramentas leves. • Familiaridade com
conventional commits, semantic-release, gitflow trifásico (feature → homolog → main com cherry-pick). • Já escreveu post-mortem público / case study técnico que outras pessoas referenciam.
Benefícios • VR/VA – Flash Benefícios • Assistência Médica – Bradesco Saúde • Assistência Odontológica – Bradesco • Programa de Orientação Pessoal – C4 Life • Day Off de Aniversário • Total Pass • Parcerias educacionais (FIAP e Alura)

Freelance / Independent Contractor Location:
Remote (Work from your own studio) Compensation:
Paid monthly on an hours delivered basis. How to Apply :
Please fill in
UJ9 MNZCs92n U8

title: Engenheiro de ia sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de ia sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Estamos em busca de um(a)
Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior
para assumir a manutenção e a evolução contínua do
Plataforma Agents de IA
— nosso framework de orquestração de agentes de IA que automatiza ciclos completos de desenvolvimento de software (refinement → dev →security → QA → deploy) em nossos projetos reais, em produção.
Esta não é
uma vaga de \"treinar modelo\" nem de \"fazer prompt em chatbot\". E engenharia de plataforma com foco em
confiabilidade, observabilidade e auto-recuperação
de agentes autônomos rodando 24/7 em produção, escrevendo código de desenvolvimento, fazendo git push, abrindo PRs, mergeando em omolog, fazendo cherry-pick para produção.
O que é o Plataforma Agents de IA Para você decidir se a vaga te interessa, precisa entender o que vai manter:
•
Orquestrador:
Le as issues (Jira), identifica issues prontas pra cada stage, dispara agentes (Claude/Open IA/Gemini/Deep Seek) com contexto rico, valida o resultado, posta comentario na issue, e avanca o status. Roda em servidores Linux, com auto-update. •
Agentes (@dev,@qa,@sec,@devops,@pm,@po,@sm,@analyst,@architect,@data-engineer,@ux-design-expert):
cada um com persona, authority matrix
definida, skills executáveis e Gates de qualidade. •
Rules:
Mais de 60 regras formais que governam o comportamento dos agentes — desde naming conventions até anti-hallucination validation em 7 camadas. Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent. •
Recovery loops:
quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota. •
Multi-repo via submodules:
projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar. •
Stack:
Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.js/Type Script (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq, integrações HTTP com Jira/Git Hub via curl + retry policy.
O que você vai fazer
Manutenção do core (40%) • Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade ciclomática. • Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário. • Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento. • Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue). • Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta \"agent crashou em loop\", \"PR criado no repo errado\", \"deploy não promoveu\") e fechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva.
Evolução de agents e rules (35%) • Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist). • Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho. • Manter o agent-authority.md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex:@dev ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146). • Criar/refatorar skills. • Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B).
Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%) • Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, Open AI CLI, Gemini CLI, Deep Seek direct). • Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex: Deep Seek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação). • Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve. • Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient; expandir cobertura). • Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection — entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria.
O que esperamos de você
Stack técnica — obrigatório •
Bash/Shell avançado e Linux
— você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs, parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de (( e porque importa. •
Node.js / Type Script
— escreve TS com strict mode, entende quando
não
usar Node (ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS). •
Git e Git Hub avançado
— cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, Git Hub Actions workflows. •
Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos
— você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que \"diga ao modelo o que
não
fazer\" raramente funciona, entende o efeito de exemplos few-shot vs zero-shot, e já debugou ao menos uma vez porque um agente está \"alucinando\" um PR que não criou.
Experiência • 5+ anos de engenharia de software produzindo sistemas em produção. • Pelo menos 1 ano com
agentes autônomos / orquestração de LLMs
em ambiente real (não bootcamp, não side project) — você sabe a diferença entre \"rodou no demo\" e \"rodou em prod 24/7 sem humano\". • Histórico comprovado de manter sistemas legados com debt técnico — você não quer \"reescrever do zero\". • Inglês técnico fluente para leitura/escrita (documentação, issues, comentários de código em inglês obrigatórios; comunicação verbal pode ser PT/EN/ZH dependendo do time).
Mentalidade •
Determinismo > magia.
Você prefere uma regex feia em bash que sempre funciona a um ML model elegante que falha em 5% dos casos. Em orquestração de agentes, 5% de falha = produto inviável. •
Forensics sobre intuição.
Antes de propor solução, você lê o log, o diff, a issue real do cliente. Não inventa hipótese. •
Documentação executável.
Quando você cria uma rule nova, ela tem detector regex que pode rodar em CI. \"Documentei em texto\" não basta. •
Empatia por agente.
Você consegue ler um prompt de 8k tokens e identificar onde o modelo vai se confundir, por que, e o que ajustar.
Diferenciais • Experiencia com Claude Agent SDK, Open AI Agents SDK, Lang Graph ou frameworks de orquestração equivalentes. • Já implementou ou manteve sistemas de
retry policy + backoff exponencial + circuit breaker
em integrações com APIs externas instáveis. • Já trabalhou com
monorepos via submodules
(nao apenas Nx/Turborepo) e entende os trade-offs. • Contribuições open-source em projetos relacionados (CLIs, dev tooling, agent frameworks). • Experiencia com
Dev Ops em servidores Linux dedicados
(não apenas k8s/cloud managed): systemd, cron, logrotate, monitoring com ferramentas leves. • Familiaridade com
conventional commits, semantic-release, gitflow trifásico (feature → homolog → main com cherry-pick). • Já escreveu post-mortem público / case study técnico que outras pessoas referenciam.
Benefícios • VR/VA – Flash Benefícios • Assistência Médica – Bradesco Saúde • Assistência Odontológica – Bradesco • Programa de Orientação Pessoal – C4 Life • Day Off de Aniversário • Total Pass • Parcerias educacionais (FIAP e Alura)

Como Hub de produção do grupo Omnicom, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.

Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com outras equipes na agência, garantindo uma comunicação eficiente até o envio de materiais para os portais do cliente (Veeva Promo Mats, FUSE). Você deve ser um pensador crítico e naturalmente interessado em aprender novos sistemas e processos para a agência e seu portfólio de marcas. Você também deve ter excelente organização, comunicação e atenção aos detalhes para garantir a precisão e eficiência dos envios, bem como a capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente orientado a prazos.

Requisitos necessários: • Bacharelado em Ciências Farmacêuticas ou área da saúde. • 2 anos ou mais de experiência em indústria farmacêutica (áreas: marketing, médica ou relacionada). • Compreensão do processo de revisão e aprovação de material promocional. • Capacidade de conciliar vários projetos enquanto cumpre os prazos do cliente. • Habilidades de planejamento, resolução de problemas, priorização e gerenciamento de tempo/organização. • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral. • Fluência em inglês: leitura, interpretação de texto, escrita e fala, pois trabalhará diretamente com o time dos EUA no dia a dia. • Altamente desejável: conhecimento do fluxo de revisão/aprovação de materiais no Veeva Promo Mats, incluindo ancoragem e anotação de referências.

title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal.3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the process.4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.G., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepancies.5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquiries.6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.G., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportunities.

title: Analista De Qualidade, Processos E Experiência Do Hóspede
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista De Qualidade, Processos E Experiência Do Hóspede em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Estamos contratando um(a) Analista de Qualidade, Processos e Experiência do Hóspede para o Quality Hotel & Suítes São Salvador, 2ª maior complexo hoteleiro em número de apartamentos em Salvador, com 304 UHs, integrante da Atlantica Hotels.Não é uma vaga de manutenção de papelada. É uma vaga de construção.Em hotelaria, Qualidade, Processos e Experiência do Hóspede não são 3 (três) frentes. São a mesma frente vista de 3 (três) perspectivas. A qualidade é a causa; o processo é o caminho; e a satisfação é o efeito.1. Escutar avaliação, pesquisa, reclamação no balcão2. Responder resposta pública + service recovery3. Classificar tema, setor, gravidade, recorrência4. Converter tema recorrente vira não conformidade5. Corrigir não conformidade vira ação no processo em conjunto com lider da área6. Medir o tema sumiu? a nota subiu?O que você vai fazer: Gestão reputacional do hotel. Análise semântica das avaliações e relatório com os temas positivos e negativos recorrentes, e monitoramento da nota frente aos concorrentes através do ReviewPro, Booking, Google, TripAdvisor — a nota isolada não diz nada; o índice relativo, sim.Ler o que o hóspede escreve, entender o que ele está realmente dizendo, e transformar reclamação recorrente em ação corretiva. Nota não sobe com resposta bonita. Sobe quando o problema para de acontecer. Service recovery: protocolo de recuperação (o que se faz, em quanto tempo, com que alçada), treinamento da Recepção e da Governança. Recuperação feita no check-out vale dez vezes a resposta pública feita depois. Jornada do hóspede: mapear os pontos de contato e cruzar as quebras com os temas recorrentes das avaliações. É onde a jornada encontra o processo. CRM de satisfação: identificar recorrentes no PMS, régua de comunicação, NPS in-house, e integração com o programa de fidelidade da Atlantica — quais deles se hospedam aqui, e como reativar. Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade, manter a ISO 9001 viva. Auditoria interna, não conformidade, plano de ação, preparação para a auditoria externa. Mapear e documentar os processos da Governança, de A&B, de Suprimentos, da Recepção e da Manutenção. Fluxograma, POP, indicador, documentação que as pessoas usam, não a que fica na gaveta. Transformação Digital, em conjunto as gerencias e o setor de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) levar IA e automação para a rotina dos setores. Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, Power BI, Clickup, Trello, etc. Não como buzzword: resolvendo o relatório que leva três horas e deveria levar cinco minutos. Construir os processos que a gestão não tem e seus paineis gerenciais, bem como auxiliar as gerencias e o setor de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) a construir soluções integradas.Quem procuramos: Superior completo · 2 a 4 anos em qualidade, processos ou dados · ISO 9001 na prática · Power BI em nível de construção · uso real de IA no trabalho (queremos ver o que você automatizou, não o certificado que você tirou) · escrita clara.O que NÃO procuramos: Alguém que confunda qualidade com burocracia. Se o seu plano é criar mais formulários, esta não é a vaga.Responsabilidades:
- Gerir a reputação nos canais de avaliação (ReviewPro, Booking, Google, TripAdvisor): responder, classificar temas recorrentes e converter reclamação em ação corretiva de processo
- Manter o sistema de gestão da qualidade conforme a ISO 9001: realizar as auditorias internas e acompanhar as auditorias externas, tratamento de não conformidades, plano de ação e preparação para auditoria externa
- Acompanhar o padrão de serviço auditado pela franqueadora e coordenar os planos de ação
- Mapear e documentar os processos operacionais (Governança, A&B, Suprimentos, Recepção, Manutenção): fluxogramas, POPs e indicadores
- Implementar ferramentas de IA e automação nas rotinas administrativas e operacionais (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, Power Automate)
- Construir e manter painéis gerenciais em Power BI
- Atuar como interlocutor entre as áreas operacionais e a Tecnologia da InformaçãoRequisitos:
- Ensino superior completo em Hotelaria, Administração, Sistemas de Informação ou correlatas
- 2 a 4 anos de experiência em qualidade, processos ou análise de dados
- Conhecimento prático da norma ISO 9001
- Power BI em nível de construção de relatórios
- Uso demonstrável de ferramentas de IA generativa em contexto profissional (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, Power BI, Clickup, Trello, etc).
- Excelente redação em portuguêsDiferenciais:
- Curso de auditor interno ISO 9001
- Experiência em hotelaria, preferencialmente com bandeira nacional ou internacional
- ReviewPro, Revinate ou plataforma equivalente
- BPMN · Power Automate, n8n ou Zapier · Lean/Green Belt · SQL básicoO que oferecemos:
- Autonomia real em um projeto em construção
- Exposição direta à gerência e à diretoria
- Uso de ferramentas de IA de ponta no dia a diaComo se candidatar:Currículo para e com o assunto "Qualidade, Processos e Experiência do Hóspede".Indica alguém? Marca nos comentários #vagas #qualidade #processos #hotelaria #salvador

  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e desenvolvimento de clientes, distribuidores, empreiteiros, consultores, proprietários de projetos e equipes de compras.
  • Experiência com projetos de iluminação, sistemas elétricos, projetos de construção, modernização para economia de energia ou aquisição baseada em projetos será considerada uma vantagem.

  • Experiência em projetos de iluminação para escritórios, escolas, hospitais, hotéis, shopping centers, fábricas, armazéns, estradas, parques, túneis, fachadas, auditórios ou infraestrutura pública.

description:

Sobre a posição no jogo

Estamos em busca de pessoas Product Managers Sênior com forte visão de negócio e capacidade de execução para liderar a evolução de nossos produtos digitais. No GRUPO SBF, nossos PMs atuam na interseção entre estratégia, dados, tecnologia e experiência do usuário, transformando desafios complexos em soluções digitais escaláveis.

Esta é uma banca de talentos estratégica para posições que impactam diretamente a eficiência operacional e a geração de valor do grupo. Buscamos profissionais que joguem em alto nível, que saibam navegar por ambientes ambíguos e que queiram liderar transformações reais no ecossistema do esporte.


Objetivos estratégicos do produto

  • Orientação a Resultados e Negócio: Conectar a estratégia do produto diretamente aos KPIs críticos do negócio, garantindo eficiência, escalabilidade e retorno sobre o investimento.
  • Decisões Baseadas em Dados: Estabelecer uma cultura analítica forte, utilizando dados quantitativos e qualitativos para embasar o roadmap, priorizações e hipóteses.
  • Inovação e Eficiência com IA: Explorar e integrar o uso de Inteligência Artificial e automações para otimizar processos internos, melhorar a experiência do usuário e acelerar o time-to-market.
  • Alinhamento de Stakeholders: Traduzir necessidades de diversas áreas (comercial, operações, marketing, etc.) em produtos digitais funcionais, garantindo uma adoção real e sustentável pelas frentes de negócio.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e desdobrar a visão, estratégia e o roadmap do produto, alinhando a tecnologia às necessidades de crescimento da companhia;
  • Conduzir processos de Discovery contínuos com usuários, clientes e áreas de negócio não-digitais, transformando dores reais em soluções de software;
  • Atuar com forte viés analítico, definindo, monitorando e comunicando KPIs claros de produto e impacto no negócio;
  • Avaliar cenários de Build vs. Buy (desenvolvimento interno vs. contratação de fornecedores), considerando custos, prazos e escalabilidade;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de Engenharia, Design, Dados e parceiros de sistemas corporativos (como SAP e plataformas de mercado);
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida do produto com metodologias ágeis, garantindo a qualidade das entregas e a melhoria contínua;
  • Liderar e influenciar stakeholders transversais de forma clara, estruturada e colaborativa, garantindo o alinhamento de prioridades complexas.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, e-commerce, ecossistemas complexos ou produtos digitais de alta escala;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de negócio , com histórico comprovado de tomada de decisão baseada em dados e métricas financeiras/operacionais;
  • Vivência prática em processos de discovery profundos com stakeholders de diferentes perfis (técnicos e não-técnicos);
  • Experiência sólida na gestão, priorização e refinamento de roadmaps e backlogs usando metodologias ágeis;
  • Comunicação clara, articulada e excelente habilidade de negociação e gestão de expectativas com múltiplos stakeholders.

  • Experiência ou interesse prático na aplicação de soluções de IA (Inteligência Artificial) , LLMs ou automações avançadas no dia a dia do produto;

  • Histórico em projetos de transformação digital ou reestruturação de produtos legados.

  • Alta taxa de adoção e engajamento das soluções lançadas pelas áreas usuárias;

  • Capacidade de entrega consistente e redução do lead time entre a descoberta da dor e o valor entregue;

title: Global Head of Customer Support
description:

Our client, a global leader in in food safety, compliance, and product integrity solutions, is seeking a Head of Customer Support. This role leads the strategy, performance, and customer experience of the global software support function within the Digital Solutions division. Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute the customer support strategy, operating model, and service frameworks aligned to ITIL best practices and division objectives.
  • Lead and develop the global support team across first, second, and advanced technical support and grow the function in line with portfolio growth.
  • Own end-to-end service delivery: including incident, problem, and change management
  • Establish, monitor, and report on the KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS measures that govern support performance
  • Provide oversight on complex technical escalations, root cause analysis, and cross-functional resolution across cloud and on-premise environments.
  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering on defect lifecycle, prioritisation, customer communication, and feeding service insights back into the product roadmap.
  • Own the support customer experience, including service reviews, senior escalations, key-account relationships, and the onboarding and adoption experience for new customers.
  • Build the knowledge management, self-service, and customer-facing documentation capabilities required to scale the function efficiently.
  • Lead adoption of automation, analytics, and AI-driven tooling; including FreshService and equivalent service management platforms
  • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing support organization
  • Provide regular reporting and insight to division leadership on support performance, customer risk, retention impact, and investment priorities.
  • Support the integration of newly acquired products into the support operating model as the portfolio evolves.


Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in customer support or technical support, with at least 3 years leading distributed support teams within SaaS or software businesses.
  • Experience managing managers or team leads, and growing a support function over time.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL, support methodologies, and service management best practices, including incident, problem, and change management.
  • Strong technical acumen across SaaS architectures, cloud environments (AWS and Microsoft Azure), web technologies, and relational databases
  • Track record managing the support relationship with Product and Engineering, including defect lifecycle, prioritisation, and roadmap influence.
  • Data-driven approach with hands-on experience using support KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS to drive measurable performance improvement.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and key customers.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Must be bilingual English and Portuguese.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience leading support integration during mergers and acquisitions or multi-product portfolio consolidation.
  • Familiarity with FreshService or equivalent enterprise service management platforms.
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted support, self-service deflection, and proactive monitoring capabilities at scale.
  • Background supporting customers in regulated industries (food, life sciences, manufacturing, or comparable).


This is a CLT role R$40-50K/month. Role is remote but some travel may be required. Both domestic and international.

title: Ad Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ad Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ad Designer (Performance Creative + Video Editor)

Location: Remote (Able to accommodate CST time)

Reports To: Marketing Director

Type : Full-Time


About Carepod

Carepod is a premium humidifier brand originally designed in Korea, known for our stainless steel water tanks, filter-free system, and elevated design. We operate across US, Canada, and Australia, with strong seasonal performance in Q4 and continued growth year over year.

We are entering our next stage of growth and are looking for a performance-driven Ad Designer to help scale our creative engine.


Role Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled Ad Designer who can both design and video edit performance-driven creative for paid media channels.


This role is responsible for turning strategy into high-converting visual assets across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms. You will work closely with our Marketing team to test, iterate, and scale creative that drives revenue — while emphasizing our premium brand positioning.


Key Responsibilities


Performance Creative Development

  • Design static and motion ad creatives for Meta, TikTok, and other paid platforms
  • Develop multiple creative variations per concept (hooks, angles, CTAs, layouts)
  • Execute rapid testing cycles based on performance data
  • Translate growth briefs into high-quality, on-brand ad assets
  • Develop creative aligned to seasonal campaigns


Video Editing & Motion

  • Create short-form video ads (9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 formats)
  • Edit UGC into performance-optimized paid ads
  • Add captions, motion graphics, overlays, callouts, and performance hooks
  • Optimize pacing and retention for the first 3–5 seconds
  • Re-cut and repackage winning content into multiple variants
  • Incorporate voiceover, testimonial layering, and sound design where needed


Performance & Iteration

  • Review performance metrics weekly with Growth team
  • Identify winning hooks, formats, angles, and messaging
  • Produce new variants based on data (not just aesthetics)
  • Help build a scalable creative testing system
  • Maintain an organized creative library with tags by angle, hook, and performance


🧠 Creative Strategy Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Marketing team on creative briefs
  • Repurpose UGC into paid formats
  • Support product launches with creative concept development
  • Contribute to creative ideation sessions


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5+ years in performance-focused creative design
  • Strong portfolio of paid social and digital ad creative
  • Strong understanding of Meta ad formats
  • Advanced proficiency in:
  • Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects)
  • CapCut / similar short-form editing tools
  • Experience designing for DTC brands (premium preferred)
  • Ability to balance brand integrity with performance urgency
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Comfortable with fast iteration cycles


What Makes You Exceptional

  • You understand the difference between brand creative and performance creative.
  • You know how to design urgency without feeling “cheap.”
  • You can turn one piece of UGC into 10 different ad variations.
  • You think in hooks and testing frameworks.
  • You care about typography, layout, and visual hierarchy.
  • You move quickly but thoughtfully.


Why This Role Matters

At our stage, creative is the lever.

Media buying is only as strong as the creative behind it. This role directly impacts revenue growth, efficiency, and scalability. You will play a central role in helping Carepod reach our next major milestone.


How to apply

Please submit your resume in English as part of your application.

title: Customer Support Specialist - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Specialist - Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist


Who We Are:

Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.


Your Role:

As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.


You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk

or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.


Why this role matters:

Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.


Responsibilities:

  • Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.


  • Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.


  • Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.


  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.


  • Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.


  • Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard


What We’re Looking For:

Must-haves:

  • Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one.
  • Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility.
  • Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone.
  • Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants.
  • Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection.
  • Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO).
  • Prior experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product.
  • Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows.
  • Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, JavaScript) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

title: Legal Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Legal Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Legal Analyst


Description

We are seeking an experienced Legal Analyst to support a growing U.S.-based law firm specializing in commercial transactions and corporate legal matters. This 100% remote position will work directly with attorneys to draft, review, and negotiate a wide variety of legal agreements while assisting with corporate governance, due diligence, legal research, and select mergers and acquisitions (M&A) matters.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, fluent in English (written and spoken), experienced supporting U.S.-based attorneys or businesses, and comfortable managing multiple legal projects simultaneously with minimal supervision.


Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, edit, and redline commercial agreements, including Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), service agreements, purchase agreements, and amendments.
  • Prepare first drafts of legal documents using attorney guidance and firm templates.
  • Conduct legal research related to commercial, corporate, contract, and business law matters.
  • Assist attorneys with corporate governance matters, entity formations, annual filings, and corporate record maintenance.
  • Support mergers and acquisitions activities, including due diligence, document organization, disclosure schedules, and transaction closing checklists.
  • Review contracts for legal, commercial, and business risks and summarize key issues for attorney review.
  • Coordinate contract execution, signature collection, and final document management.
  • Maintain organized electronic legal files and document management systems.
  • Track transaction timelines, deadlines, and attorney action items across multiple client matters.
  • Assist with client correspondence and preparation of legal deliverables.
  • Support process improvements and standardization of legal templates and document workflows.


Requirements

  • Education & Licensure: Law Degree (LL.B., J.D., or regional equivalent) from an accredited law school. Active bar admission/license to practice law from Brazil, or a relevant international jurisdiction is strictly required.
  • Experience: 5–10 years of post-qualification experience (PQE) practicing corporate law, either within a reputable law firm or as in-house counsel.
  • M&A Expertise: Proven track record of actively working on M&A transactions and drafting/negotiating complex purchase agreements.
  • Language: Native or bilingual fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory, with the ability to draft complex legal documents in English.
  • U.S. Context: Deep experience supporting U.S.-based companies, cross-border transactions, or working under common law principles.
  • Negotiation Skills: Strong commercial acumen with a proven ability to redline contracts effectively and negotiate directly with opposing counsel.


Technical Requirements

  • Document Management: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word (specifically tracking changes and document comparison), Excel, and Google Workspace.
  • Legal Tech: Experience utilizing Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms (e.g., Ironclad, DocuSign, ContractWorks) and digital signature workflows.
  • Collaboration: Comfortable operating in agile, remote environments using tools like Teams, Slack, and Zoom.
  • Innovation: Experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, specialized legal AI) to drive legal operations efficiency and streamline workflows.
