title: Senior  Bussiness Analyst - Finance
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Bussiness Analyst - Finance em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive transformation. Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep industry knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Finance , a client-facing lead role responsible for supporting complex HOIST projects and leading the implementation of finance-related ERP modules across different regional clients.


This role acts as an escalation point for Business Analysts and Junior Business Analysts within the finance domain, providing functional expertise, guidance, and leadership throughout project delivery. The Senior Business Analyst – Finance will work closely with clients, stakeholders, Project Managers, Solutions Architects, development teams, and finance users to gather requirements, define solutions, support implementation, and ensure the successful adoption of financial processes and ERP functionalities.


If you have strong IFS finance expertise, experience leading ERP implementation or upgrade projects, and enjoy working directly with clients to deliver high-impact financial business solutions, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

• Lead the gathering, analysis, and definition of finance-related business requirements, ensuring alignment with client needs, financial processes, reporting requirements, and ERP capabilities.

• Design, implement, test, and support finance-focused ERP solutions in collaboration with clients, stakeholders, Project Managers, Solutions Architects, development teams, and functional teams.

• Provide guidance on finance best practices, ERP configuration, process optimization, compliance, financial controls, and system performance improvements.

• Perform gap analysis and propose scalable solutions to improve financial workflows, system functionality, efficiency, accuracy, and user adoption.

• Translate complex financial, functional, and technical concepts into clear information for non-technical stakeholders.

• Act as an escalation point and provide guidance to Business Analysts and Junior Business Analysts within the finance domain.

• Support project planning, estimation, risk management, design discussions, cross-functional communication, training, documentation, and issue resolution.

• Maintain IFS finance expertise, stay updated on ERP and industry best practices, and act as a subject matter expert for finance processes, accounting workflows, and ERP functionality.


Must Have

• 5+ years of experience in finance, accounting, financial systems, or finance-related business analysis.

• Experience with ERP implementation or upgrade projects, preferably with IFS Finance modules.

• Strong knowledge of financial processes, including GL, AP, AR, fixed assets, budgeting, reporting, and financial controls.

• 3+ years of experience in client-facing roles.

• Fluent in English, with strong communication, analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

• Advanced Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel.

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Availability to travel 25%–50% and legally entitled to work in the country of application.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career development opportunities with training and mentorship.

• A collaborative, diverse, and global work environment.

• Involvement in complex international ERP and IFS finance-focused projects.

• Opportunities to act as a finance subject matter expert and contribute to business transformation initiatives.

• Health and wellness benefits to support work-life balance.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to make an impact and grow your career in a dynamic, global environment, Hoist is the place for you. Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, flexibility, expertise, and professional growth.

title: Bilingual Customer Service Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bilingual Customer Service Representative em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT MASTERPRO

MasterPro Installs is a U.S. appliance delivery and installation company operating in the U.S. We are an authorized installer for some of the largest retailers in the United States. Our trucks deliver and install refrigerators, ranges, dishwashers, and cooktops in customers' homes every day, and our remote team in Brazil is the voice our customers hear before and after every visit.

THE ROLE

You will be the direct line between MasterPro and our U.S. customers. You will confirm appointments, solve scheduling problems, follow up after installations, and make sure every customer interaction ends better than it started. You will work inside our CRM and operations systems all day; everything you do gets documented, tracked, and measured. Our field teams are scored on customer surveys, and your work directly moves those scores.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Handle inbound and outbound customer contact by phone, SMS, and email: appointment confirmations, rescheduling, arrival windows, and post-installation follow-up.

• Work daily inside our CRM and operations platforms, keeping every customer record complete, accurate, and up to date — no exceptions.

• Coordinate in real time with U.S.-based dispatch and field teams to solve same-day problems: delays, access issues, product problems, and customer questions.

• Drive customer survey participation and satisfaction after every completed job — our teams are measured on surveys, and you own the follow-up that makes them happen.

• De-escalate frustrated customers with patience and professionalism, and turn complaints into resolved cases with documented outcomes.

• Flag recurring issues and process gaps to management — we promote problem-solvers, not ticket-closers.

REQUIRED

• Fluent, professional English — spoken and written. You will talk with American customers by phone all day. Interviews are conducted 100% in English.

• Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience with CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Monday.com, or similar). You know how to live inside a CRM: logging, updating, searching, and following workflows.

• 100% remote readiness: reliable high-speed internet, a quiet professional workspace, a computer in good condition, and a quality headset.

• Availability during U.S. Pacific Time business hours (afternoon/evening in Brazil).

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience serving U.S. or other international customers.

• Experience with Monday.com, scheduling systems, or logistics/home-services operations.

• Spanish, in addition to English — many of our customers are bilingual.

WHAT WE OFFER

• 100% remote work from anywhere in Brazil, on a long-term engagement with a growing U.S. company.

• Compensation in line with experience, paid reliably every month.

• Real growth: our Brazil team members grow into finance, operations, and coordination roles as the company expands into new U.S. markets.

• Direct exposure to U.S. operations, tools, and standards — you will work with modern systems and real automation, not spreadsheets and improvisation.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply here on LinkedIn AND send your resume in English to with the subject line \"Customer Service — Brazil\". Include one short paragraph, in English, telling us about a difficult customer you turned around. Applications without the paragraph will not be reviewed — that paragraph is the first test.

The Role


The VEXOS Platform Manager supports the delivery and day-to-day management of VEXOS client deployments. You will work closely with our Visualization PMs, development team, and founder to keep projects on track and clients well-supported.


You are organized, communicative, and detail-oriented. You follow process, flag issues early, and represent the platform professionally to clients. You execute the vision — you don't set it.

• Coordinating VEXOS project timelines alongside the Visualization PM

• Scheduling and running client onboarding and training calls using provided materials

• Managing client communication after delivery — answering questions, logging change requests, and escalating issues to the right internal person

Experience

Skills

What We Offer

• 100% remote — work from Brazil or Mexico

• Direct day-to-day collaboration with the founder

• A stable, long-term role in a growing company

• Opportunity to grow into greater responsibility as VEXOS scales

title: Analista de Operações Regulatórias Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Operações Regulatórias Pleno em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção do grupo Omnicom, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O seu papel:

Como Analista Pleno de Operações Regulatórias, você trabalhará no envio de materiais promocionais e não promocionais para o portal de revisão e aprovação dos clientes, garantindo que os materiais estejam em conformidade com os requisitos regulatórios e as especificidades da marca, seguindo os padrões da indústria, bem como os processos do cliente. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com outras equipes na agência, garantindo uma comunicação eficiente até o envio de materiais para os portais do cliente (Veeva PromoMats, FUSE). Você deve ser um pensador crítico e naturalmente interessado em aprender novos sistemas e processos para a agência e seu portfólio de marcas. Você também deve ter excelente organização, comunicação e atenção aos detalhes para garantir a precisão e eficiência dos envios, bem como a capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente orientado a prazos.


Suas responsabilidades:

• Trabalhar em parceria com a equipe de Operações Regulatórias dos EUA no processo de submissão de materiais para aprovação de MLR;

• Garantir que as submissões atendam a todos os requisitos necessários de acordo com os requisitos regulatórios, necessidades e SOPs de cada cliente;

• Colaborar com equipes internas da marca (atendimento ao cliente, escritores, PMs) na preparação da submissão de materiais desenvolvidos pela agência para as submissões médicas/legais/regulatórias (MLR) do cliente, garantindo que as submissões sejam concluídas corretamente;

• Participar de reuniões de início de projetos e alinhamento com as equipes da marca dos EUA, conforme necessário;

• Auxiliar na revisão e implementação de novos processos de submissão de materiais;

• Manter uma boa comunicação, ser proativo em sua abordagem e cultivar relacionamentos com equipes parceiras.


Requisitos necessários:

• Bacharelado em Ciências Farmacêuticas ou área da saúde.

• 2 anos ou mais de experiência em indústria farmacêutica (áreas: marketing, médica ou relacionada).

• Compreensão do processo de revisão e aprovação de material promocional.

• Capacidade de conciliar vários projetos enquanto cumpre os prazos do cliente.

• Habilidades de planejamento, resolução de problemas, priorização e gerenciamento de tempo/organização.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral.

• Fluência em inglês: leitura, interpretação de texto, escrita e fala, pois trabalhará diretamente com o time dos EUA no dia a dia.

• Altamente desejável: conhecimento do fluxo de revisão/aprovação de materiais no Veeva PromoMats, incluindo ancoragem e anotação de referências.

Modelo de contratação: CLT

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Entry Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.


Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance.


Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.


Position Overview

We’re looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.


What You’ll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.


Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.


Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Coordenador(a) de Operações
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordenador(a) de Operações em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas.   • Gerenciar o relacionamento com transportadoras, acompanhando indicadores de desempenho, níveis de serviço e oportunidades de evolução da operação;
  • Participar de projetos de integração sistêmica junto aos times de Produto e Tecnologia, apoiando a implementação de novas soluções logísticas;
  • Garantir a documentação, revisão e evolução dos processos operacionais, mantendo playbooks e fluxos sempre atualizados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e experiência utilizando indicadores para tomada de decisão;

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em startups, logitechs, marketplaces ou empresas de tecnologia;

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.


O que oferecemos:

  • Férias remuneradas: desfrute de 30 dias de férias remuneradas por ano para recarregar suas energias e relaxar;
  • Programa Super-Get-Super: indique um talento e receba um bônus;
  • 😊Cultura colaborativa: nossa cultura é baseada na confiança, parceria e foco em resultados. Oferecemos um ambiente com autonomia e transparência;
  • Incentivo ao desenvolvimento: estamos comprometidos com a excelência e o aprendizado contínuo. Oferecemos avaliações semestrais, conversas de one-on-one, feedbacks construtivos, e muito mais;
  • Programa de Stock Option: possibilidade de se tornar sócio da empresa e participar diretamente do nosso crescimento. Somos reconhecidos como uma das startups mais promissoras do Brasil pela lista 100 Startups to Watch.

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

As an Accounting Analyst, you’ll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You’ll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our finance and operations departments.


You’ll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of our financial records, preparing key financial statements, and supporting the business with timely and data-driven reporting. This role requires a proactive approach, a strong grasp of Brazilian tax regulations, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws (SPED, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, etc.).
  • Prepare and analyze financial statements (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial, Fluxo de Caixa).
  • Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations.
  • Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures.
  • Prepare and analyze the company’s accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency.
  • Develop accounting reports to support decision-making.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS).
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings.
  • Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil.
  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Are proficient in accounting software — knowledge of Odoo is a plus.
  • Excel in advanced Excel skills and familiarity with financial analysis tools.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering reliable financial information.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Third Interview: A conversation with our CFO to align on technical expectations and ensure you're the right fit for our finance team.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media 🚀


We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.

With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!


Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! title: VEXOS Platform Manager (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para VEXOS Platform Manager (Remote) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're Hiring | VEXOS Platform Manager

Remote · Full-Time | Based in Brazil


The Render Pros is the presales creative engine behind some of the most ambitious real estate developments in the world. We build photorealistic visualizations, immersive digital experiences, and VEXOS — our proprietary presales platform that transforms how developers market and sell high-value assets before they're built.


We're growing and we need a sharp, reliable operator to help us run VEXOS smoothly.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


About The Render Pros / VEXOS


We are a vertically integrated presales studio. Our clients are real estate developers, luxury asset companies, and investment groups working on projects across the Western hemisphere. VEXOS is our platform product — a fully branded, data-driven presales environment that combines 3D visualization, buyer engagement tools, and lead intelligence. We define the strategy. You help us execute it.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


The Role


The VEXOS Platform Manager supports the delivery and day-to-day management of VEXOS client deployments. You will work closely with our Visualization PMs, development team, and founder to keep projects on track and clients well-supported.


You are organized, communicative, and detail-oriented. You follow process, flag issues early, and represent the platform professionally to clients. You execute the vision — you don't set it.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


✅ What You'll Be Responsible For


• Coordinating VEXOS project timelines alongside the Visualization PM

• Scheduling and running client onboarding and training calls using provided materials

• Managing client communication after delivery — answering questions, logging change requests, and escalating issues to the right internal person

• Keeping project trackers, onboarding checklists, and documentation up to date

• Following established delivery SOPs and flagging when something is off-track

• Supporting the creation of training materials, guides, and client-facing documentation as directed

• Being the day-to-day client contact for active VEXOS accounts


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


What We're Looking For


Experience

• 2–4 years in a client-facing coordination, account support, or digital project management role

• Experience working with SaaS platforms, creative tech, or digital products is a plus

• Background in real estate or luxury industries is a bonus, not a requirement


Skills

• Exceptional written and spoken English — you will be communicating with US-based executive clients daily

• Comfortable learning and navigating new software platforms quickly

• Able to explain digital tools clearly to non-technical users

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail

• Responsive, professional, and calm under pressure

• Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift


Mindset

• You follow through. Every time.

• You communicate proactively — you don't go quiet when things get complicated

• You take pride in representing a premium brand to premium clients

• You're here to execute at a high level and grow with the company


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


🛠 Tools You'll Work With


VEXOS platform (proprietary) · Notion or Asana · Zoom · Google Workspace · Loom


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


What We Offer


• Competitive salary in USD

• 100% remote — work from Brazil or Mexico

• Direct day-to-day collaboration with the founder

• A stable, long-term role in a growing company

• Opportunity to grow into greater responsibility as VEXOS scales


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


How to Apply


Send your CV and a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) covering:

1. Who you are and what you've managed

2. Why this role interests you

3. One example of how you handled a difficult client situation


Applications without the Loom video will not be reviewed.


Apply via DM or email:

#hiring #remotejobs #vexos #therenderpos #proptech #projectmanager #clientsuccess #remotework #Brazil #Mexico #latinamerica

title: Cloud Architect – Google Cloud (GCP)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Architect – Google Cloud (GCP) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Cloud Architect – Google Cloud (GCP) com perfil altamente técnico e vocação para ensino e evangelização.

Essa pessoa atuará principalmente na capacitação de clientes e equipes , conduzindo treinamentos, workshops e apresentações técnicas em toda a América Latina. O foco não é atuação diária em projetos ou pré-vendas, mas sim disseminação de conhecimento, apoio consultivo e desenvolvimento de conteúdos técnicos que impulsionem a adoção de soluções em Google Cloud Platform.

O perfil ideal combina experiência sólida em arquitetura de soluções em GCP com excelente comunicação, didática e capacidade de influenciar diferentes públicos.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Conduzir treinamentos técnicos, workshops e palestras (principalmente em espanhol) sobre GCP;
  • Desenvolver demonstrações práticas (hands-on) e provas de conceito (PoCs) para fins educacionais;
  • Apoiar clientes e parceiros na compreensão e adoção de soluções em GCP;
  • Desenhar arquiteturas de referência escaláveis, resilientes e seguras;
  • Atuar como referência técnica na disseminação de boas práticas em cloud;
  • Produzir e manter materiais técnicos, apresentações e conteúdos educacionais atualizados;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de modernização de aplicações e transformação digital;
  • Compartilhar tendências e inovações em cloud, serverless e cloud-native;
  • Interagir com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio em toda a América Latina.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida com Google Cloud Platform (GCP);
  • Experiência em arquitetura de soluções em cloud;
  • Vivência com modernização de aplicações e arquiteturas cloud-native e serverless;
  • Conhecimento prático em serviços GCP como: Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, Compute Engine, VPC, IAM, Load Balancing, Cloud Monitoring e Logging;
  • Experiência com containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes / GKE);
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform);
  • Experiência com CI/CD e práticas de DevOps;
  • Vivência com migração de ambientes para cloud;
  • Conhecimento em redes (networking) e ambientes Linux;
  • Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento;
  • Conhecimento em APIs e API Management;
  • Espanhol avançado para condução de treinamentos e apresentações.


Desejáveis:

  • Firebase;
  • BigQuery, Pub/Sub e Dataflow;
  • Apigee;
  • Anthos;
  • Cloud SQL e Memorystore;
  • Vertex AI (AI/ML em GCP);
  • Looker;
  • Kafka;
  • GitOps (ArgoCD);
  • Istio;
  • FinOps;
  • Práticas de SRE;
  • Segurança em cloud.

rkets.To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive technol

ogies.We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional g


rowth.

title: Educador Físico PJ
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Educador Físico PJ em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA EDUCADOR FÍSICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Educador Físico! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar atendimentos por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Educador Físico , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Realizar orientação esportiva por vídeo e telefone com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo acolhedor, empático e resolutivo na maioria das orientações de acordo com os objetivos e dúvidas de saúde trazidos pelos beneficiários, respeitando os diferentes gêneros ou grupos etários;
  • Contatar os beneficiários através de orientações telefônicas e/ou chamada de vídeo para aplicação de anamnese esportiva, com o objetivo de identificar a familiaridade do beneficiário com a atividade física e suas limitações/ restrições de saúde bem como necessidades de melhorias nos hábitos esportivos, para realizar um treino focado e personalizado a cada indivíduo, considerando sua condição clínica, hábitos, comportamentos e objetivo do beneficiário;
  • Esclarecer dúvidas esportivas pontuais, conforme demanda trazida pelo beneficiário garantindo a sua satisfação;
  • Elaborar treinos esportivos personalizados, conforme necessidade e objetivo de cada beneficiário e posterior envio ao mesmo através de e-mail, dentro do prazo estipulado para que melhorem a sua saúde e desta forma atinjam os melhores resultados do programa;
  • Realizar acompanhamento esportivo periódico, para checar se o objetivo esperado está sendo atingido e avaliar se há necessidade de desenvolver novo material;
  • Enviar e-mail e/ou sms, whatsapp para verificar a disponibilidade de horário dos beneficiários, com o objetivo de maior assertividade nas ligações e gerar maior adesão ao programa;
  • Ter visão clínica ampla para saber quando e como solicitar suporte junto a equipe multiprofissional (nutricionista, médico e enfermagem), visando o atendimento das necessidades do beneficiário;
  • Registrar todas as orientações e informações (prestadas e coletadas) aos beneficiários e colaboradores da Teladoc Health em sistema eletrônico e/ou planilha de Excel, visando manter atualizada as bases e tratando de forma confidencial, tornando os processos seguros, éticos e legais;
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática centrada na pessoa;
  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes;
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética da Educação Esportiva, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: SUPERIOR COMPLETO EM EDUCAÇÃO FÍSICA


EXPERIÊNCIA

  • Vivência em montagem de treinos e atuação como Personal Trainer.


CONHECIMENTO ESPECÍFICOS PARA A FUNÇÃO

  • Conhecimentos e Habilidades no Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point).
  • Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


COMPETÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS

  • Capacidade investigativa;
  • Raciocínio clínico.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


*Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CREF do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em educação física.

title: Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Editor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is a boutique creative agency that builds campaigns, brand systems, and content for technology and AI-driven companies. We work with brands you've heard of and some you're about to.


We're looking for a Video Editor + Motion Designer based in Brazil to join our team full-time. This is a remote position reporting directly to our Creative Director.


What you'll do:

  • Edit video content for campaigns, social, product launches, and brand storytelling
  • Create motion graphics, from logo animations to full explainer sequences
  • Experiment with AI video tools (Runway, Higgsfield, etc.) to push creative boundaries
  • Deliver across formats: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 — for web, social, ads, and beyond
  • Work fast, think creatively, and bring your own ideas to the project. We value your perspective!


What we're looking for:

  • Strong portfolio showing both video editing and motion graphics work
  • Proficiency in After Effects, Premiere (or similar NLE)
  • Experience with (or genuine curiosity about) AI-generated video tools
  • Ability to work independently, manage your time, and meet deadlines
  • Great taste in design, knowledge of the latest video editing trends and styles.


Bonus points:

  • Experience creating content for tech, SaaS, or consumer brands,
  • Basis English. But don't worry, your teammates are also based in Brazil.


We use the latest AI tools to move fast and deliver high-quality work for ambitious companies. If you want creative freedom, variety, and the chance to grow with us, please don't hesitate to apply.


------


Estamos Contratando: Editor de Vídeo / Motion Designer (Brasil, Remoto)

A Ten16 Creative é uma agência criativa boutique que desenvolve campanhas, sistemas de marca e conteúdo para empresas de tecnologia e inteligência artificial. Trabalhamos com marcas que você já conhece — e algumas que está prestes a conhecer.

Estamos procurando um Editor de Vídeo + Motion Designer baseado no Brasil para integrar nosso time em tempo integral. A posição é 100% remota, com reporte direto ao nosso Diretor Criativo.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Editar conteúdo em vídeo para campanhas, redes sociais, lançamentos de produto e storytelling de marca
  • Criar motion graphics — de animações de logo a sequências completas de explainer
  • Experimentar com ferramentas de vídeo com IA (Runway, Higgsfield, etc.) para expandir os limites criativos
  • Entregar em múltiplos formatos: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 — para web, social, ads e mais
  • Trabalhar rápido, pensar criativamente e trazer ideias — não apenas executar briefings

O que estamos buscando:

  • Portfólio sólido mostrando trabalhos de edição de vídeo e motion graphics
  • Domínio de After Effects, Premiere (ou similar)
  • Experiência com (ou curiosidade genuína sobre) ferramentas de vídeo gerado por IA
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente, gerenciar seu tempo e cumprir prazos
  • Bom gosto. Sério — a gente se importa com craft.

Pontos extras:

  • Experiência criando conteúdo para marcas de tech, SaaS ou consumer
  • Conforto para trabalhar em inglês (nossos clientes são dos EUA)

Aqui não é fábrica. Somos um time pequeno fazendo trabalho de alta qualidade para empresas ambiciosas. Se você quer liberdade criativa, variedade e a chance de crescer com a gente — manda seu portfólio aqui embaixo ou me chama no DM.

title: Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Editor em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is a boutique creative agency that builds campaigns, brand systems, and content for technology and AI-driven companies. We work with brands you've heard of and some you're about to.


We're looking for a Video Editor + Motion Designer based in Brazil to join our team full-time. This is a remote position reporting directly to our Creative Director.


What you'll do:

  • Edit video content for campaigns, social, product launches, and brand storytelling
  • Create motion graphics, from logo animations to full explainer sequences
  • Experiment with AI video tools (Runway, Higgsfield, etc.) to push creative boundaries
  • Deliver across formats: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 — for web, social, ads, and beyond
  • Work fast, think creatively, and bring your own ideas to the project. We value your perspective!


What we're looking for:

  • Strong portfolio showing both video editing and motion graphics work
  • Proficiency in After Effects, Premiere (or similar NLE)
  • Experience with (or genuine curiosity about) AI-generated video tools
  • Ability to work independently, manage your time, and meet deadlines
  • Great taste in design, knowledge of the latest video editing trends and styles.


Bonus points:

  • Experience creating content for tech, SaaS, or consumer brands,
  • Basis English. But don't worry, your teammates are also based in Brazil.


We use the latest AI tools to move fast and deliver high-quality work for ambitious companies. If you want creative freedom, variety, and the chance to grow with us, please don't hesitate to apply.


------


Estamos Contratando: Editor de Vídeo / Motion Designer (Brasil, Remoto)

A Ten16 Creative é uma agência criativa boutique que desenvolve campanhas, sistemas de marca e conteúdo para empresas de tecnologia e inteligência artificial. Trabalhamos com marcas que você já conhece — e algumas que está prestes a conhecer.

Estamos procurando um Editor de Vídeo + Motion Designer baseado no Brasil para integrar nosso time em tempo integral. A posição é 100% remota, com reporte direto ao nosso Diretor Criativo.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Editar conteúdo em vídeo para campanhas, redes sociais, lançamentos de produto e storytelling de marca
  • Criar motion graphics — de animações de logo a sequências completas de explainer
  • Experimentar com ferramentas de vídeo com IA (Runway, Higgsfield, etc.) para expandir os limites criativos
  • Entregar em múltiplos formatos: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 — para web, social, ads e mais
  • Trabalhar rápido, pensar criativamente e trazer ideias — não apenas executar briefings

O que estamos buscando:

  • Portfólio sólido mostrando trabalhos de edição de vídeo e motion graphics
  • Domínio de After Effects, Premiere (ou similar)
  • Experiência com (ou curiosidade genuína sobre) ferramentas de vídeo gerado por IA
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente, gerenciar seu tempo e cumprir prazos
  • Bom gosto. Sério — a gente se importa com craft.

Pontos extras:

  • Experiência criando conteúdo para marcas de tech, SaaS ou consumer
  • Conforto para trabalhar em inglês (nossos clientes são dos EUA)

Aqui não é fábrica. Somos um time pequeno fazendo trabalho de alta qualidade para empresas ambiciosas. Se você quer liberdade criativa, variedade e a chance de crescer com a gente — manda seu portfólio aqui embaixo ou me chama no DM.

title: PMO (Escritório de projetos)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para PMO (Escritório de projetos) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre o netLex


O netLex surgiu para revolucionar o mercado de Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), fazendo fluir o trabalho de todos que lidam com documentos. Acreditamos que a experiência deve ser a mais agradável possível e, por que não, divertida?!


Para alcançarmos nosso objetivo, usamos tecnologia para otimizar os processos de formalização e gestão de documentos e, ao fazermos isso, conseguimos extrair mais dados e gerar inteligência. Assim, nossos clientes ( os maiores da América Latina) podem alcançar um novo patamar de excelência e ter acesso a uma série de informações estratégicas para os ajudar a tomar decisões melhores.


Estamos crescendo os nossos times buscando novos talentos que queiram transformar o mundo da gestão do ciclo de vida de documentos com soluções inovadoras. Aqui na netLex temos uma cultura bem forte, que se baseia em um ambiente colaborativo e descontraído para nossos netLecos e netLecas!


Valorizamos a diversidade e são muito bem-vindas candidaturas de pessoas pretas, mulheres, PCD, indígenas, LGBTQIA+ ou outros grupos minorizados 🧡


Sobre a oportunidade:


Estruturar e liderar o escritório de gestão de projetos (PMO) da netLex, garantindo governança, padronização e entrega de valor nos projetos de implantação. O foco desta posição é criar uma operação de projetos eficiente e escalável, traduzindo complexidade operacional em resultados claros para clientes Enterprise e para a alta liderança, enquanto desenvolve uma cultura de projetos orientada a resultados em toda a organização.


Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades comoPMO por aqui?


Governança e Padronização

  • Definir e padronizar metodologias de gestão de projetos (Ágil, Tradicional/Preditivo ou Híbrido) em toda a organização.
  • Desenvolver modelos de documentos, relatórios, fluxos de aprovação e ferramentas obrigatórias para os gerentes de projeto.
  • Auditar projetos periodicamente para garantir conformidade com normas e critérios estabelecidos.
  • Monitorar indicadores globais de saúde do portfólio (ROI, desvio de prazo, controle de orçamento).
  • Reportar o status consolidado de todas as iniciativas para a alta liderança por meio de dashboards e relatórios executivos.

Gestão de Recursos e Riscos

  • Otimizar a alocação de profissionais, equipes e orçamentos entre projetos para evitar gargalos.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos interdependentes que afetam múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, traçando planos de contingência corporativos.
  • Intervir na resolução de conflitos por recursos entre diferentes departamentos, inclusive organizando a prática de gestão de partes interessadas, envolvendo clientes externos.

Desenvolvimento de Pessoas e Cultura

  • Treinar gerentes de projeto e lideranças táticas nas melhores práticas de mercado.
  • Promover uma cultura de eficiência, entrega de valor e foco em resultados por toda a estrutura.
  • Gerenciar, capacitar e motivar a equipe técnica e funcional, promovendo um ambiente saudável e de melhoria contínua.


Para que você seja considerado(a) para a posição, é necessário apresentar:


  • Certificação PMP (Project Management Professional) ou PMO-CP (PMO Certified Practitioner).
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (projetos globais e atendimento a clientes internacionais).
  • Forte experiência em Gestão de Projetos, PMO ou Liderança, incluindo coordenação de programas, gestão de portfólios múltiplos (PPM) e interface com C-level.
  • Experiência em sistemas no modelo SaaS.
  • Domínio de frameworks ágeis (Scrum e Kanban) e metodologias tradicionais (Waterfall).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de portfólio (Clarity PPM, Asana Enterprise ou MS Project).
  • Capacidade de Storytelling com Dados — transformar planilhas complexas em apresentações com narrativa lógica e plano de ação proposto.
  • Vivência em Change Management : análise de impacto cultural, mapeamento de stakeholders e planos de comunicação.
  • Ensino superior completo.


Nossos olhos irão brilhar, se você:


  • Espanhol avançado/fluente (diferencial para atendimento a clientes Latam).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI e criação de dashboards executivos (Power BI ou similares).
  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia de alto crescimento ou scale-ups.


O que oferecemos:


Modelo Remote First : trabalhe de onde quiser de forma remota, mas caso queira, poderá visitar nossa sede localizada no coração de Belo Horizonte;

Equipamentos de trabalho : disponibilizamos o principal que você precisa para poder trabalhar com tranquilidade;

Jornada de trabalho flexível : aqui priorizamos entregas de qualidade, e não tempo desprendido;

Cartão de benefício flexível Caju : valores mensais para você usar da forma que quiser (Refeição, alimentação, home office, mobilidade e cultura);

Plano de saúde e odontológico;

Day off de aniversário : tire um dia para curtir e relaxar em até 90 dias após seu aniversário;

Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

Gamificação em nossa plataforma de engajamento : compute netcoins que serão revertidos em prêmios a cada trimestre;

Educalex : benefício de incentivo à educação para a realização de cursos, workshops, palestras, aquisição de livros e mais!

Stock Options : possibilidade de adquirir ações da netLex de acordo com seu desenvolvimento em nosso plano de carreiras.

title: Social Media Lead/Community Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Social Media Lead/Community Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.


What you’ll do:

• Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

• Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content

• Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

• Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

• Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

• Analyze performance and double down on what works


Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting
  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips
2. Podcast Clip Strategy
  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan
  • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where
  • Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)
3. Growth & Optimization
  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks
  • Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:
  • Views
  • Engagement
  • Follower growth
  • A/B test captions, formats, and posting times
4. Platform Expertise
  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms
  • Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)
5. Systems & Organization
  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system
  • Track posted content and performance metrics
  • Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting
6. Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • Editors (to refine clips)
  • Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)
  • Leadership (to align on growth strategy)


What we’re looking for:

• Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

• Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

• Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior

• Ability to manage both content output + community interaction

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)
  • Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing. 
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack
  • Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)
  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients
Bonus:

• Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

• Background in content editing or scripting

• Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

title: Head of Compliance (Brazil resident)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance (Brazil resident) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.


Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Head of Compliance on the ground. The authorisation itself depends on having someone the BCB trusts in this seat — someone who treats AML/CFT, KYC, and disclosure as the actual job, not paperwork around it. In your first year, you will have stood up the compliance program the regulator expects to see and built the company's track record with the BCB from zero.


What you'll do

  • Hold statutory officer responsibility for compliance at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Own the design and effectiveness of the AML/CFT and KYC program, including transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and suspicious activity reporting
  • Act as the primary point of contact with the BCB and COAF for compliance matters, including audits, inspections, and ad hoc information requests
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the compliance workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline


What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship, with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing officer or director seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • Direct compliance experience at a BCB-regulated institution (bank, securities broker/distributor, foreign exchange dealer) or at a crypto exchange/VASP
  • Hands-on ownership of AML/CFT and KYC programs, not just oversight of someone else's
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires


Nice-to-have

  • Prior compliance experience specifically within a crypto exchange or VASP
  • AML/compliance certification (e.g. CAMS, ICA)
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB or COAF on audits, inspections, or filings

title: Senior Project Management Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Project Management Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Project Manager will serve as the primary point of contact between clients and the internal team, ensuring effective expectation management, high‑quality delivery, and consistent communication. This role is responsible for leading the project end‑to‑end, ensuring that all deliverables are completed as planned while keeping internal and external stakeholders aligned.

Responsibilities

• Act as the main liaison between the client and internal team for day‑to‑day communication and expectation management.

• Own the project and its deliverables, maintaining direct communication with the client and stakeholders.

• Define project scope, goals, and deliverables in collaboration with senior management and stakeholders.

• Develop full‑scale project plans and all related communication documents, ensuring clear and consistent communication channels.

• Estimate required resources and oversee the project lifecycle using established methodologies.

• Create budget proposals, update financial forecasts using SOW numbers and projections, and recommend budget adjustments when needed.

• Plan, schedule, and track project timelines, milestones, and resources, updating PSA Resource Forecasting weekly.

• Prepare and deliver progress reports, proposals, requirements documentation, and presentations.

• Proactively manage scope changes, identify potential crises, and develop contingency plans, documenting all blockers, risks, and changes.

• Define project success criteria and ensure alignment across all involved parties throughout the project lifecycle.

• Conduct project post‑mortems and produce recommendations to highlight successful and unsuccessful elements.

• Strong English speaking skills along with English.


Requirements


• Direct work experience in a project management role, including all aspects of process development and execution.

• Strong familiarity with project management software such as Microsoft Project, Basecamp, or similar tools.

• Solid working knowledge of current IT technologies across a broad range of solutions.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal and operational abilities.

• Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

• Extensive experience with project management practices and tools to create, manage, and track project performance, deliverables, and outcomes.

• Proven ability to lead teams and drive projects to successful completion.

• Ability to lead development and implementation teams.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a related field.

• PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is a plus.

• Development and training program

title: Project Manager - Civil Engineer

title: Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategy & Operations Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you’ll be doing

  • Building and optimising scalable processes to continue Revolut's hyper-growth
  • Leading and executing core infrastructure projects
  • Exploring and defining which projects the team should prioritise, and setting a timeline to reach goals quickly
  • Searching for new features to provide a seamless customer experience
  • Managing critical vendor relationships and building performance tracking systems
  • Developing strategic supply chain partnerships and negotiating commercial terms

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • 2+ years of work experience in a fast-paced environment
  • A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects end to end
  • A magic skill to break complex problems into smaller ones
  • To enjoy working with data
  • Natural curiosity and a will to make an impact
  • An interest in the financial industry

Nice to have

  • Experience coding with SQL, Python, or R

Compensation range

  • Poland: PLN12,600 - PLN35,800 gross monthly*
  • Lithuania: €2,500 - €8,000 gross monthly*
  • Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process

title: Senior DBA + C#/.NET Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior DBA + C#/.NET Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior Database Administrator with C#/.NET development experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will interact with/improve code related to our software database queries, while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  
  • Prior team lead experience

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de Espanhol em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Travel Buddies

Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen.


Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür.


Was du machst

Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns:


Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus.


Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per WhatsApp, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst.


Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden.


Was du mitbringen musst

  • Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen.
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch.
  • Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per WhatsApp und im Video-Call.


Was zusätzlich hilft

  • Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse
  • Englisch fließend
  • Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung
  • Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen
  • Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business
  • Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im Amazonas


Was wir bieten

  • Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt.
  • Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen.
  • Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen.
  • Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst.
  • Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.

    • Eine Frage in deiner Bewerbung: Welchen Ort oder welche Begegnung in Brasilien könntest du möglich machen, die ein Tourist allein nie findet?

Team Lead & Trainer — Remote — EOIR + USCIS + Federal Litigation (Bonus)


Cunha Law PLLC — a U.S. immigration law firm based in Washington, DC — is hiring a senior immigration paralegal to lead and train our paralegal team. This is a technical leadership and team-development role : you'll be the person who trains our paralegals, reviews the team's work, and makes sure every case leaves the office at the firm's standard — across both immigration court (EOIR / removal defense) and affirmative filings before USCIS.


We are not an immigration consultancy, and we don't compete with form-fillers. Every case at Cunha Law is handled as a real legal matter — eligibility analysis, case strategy, legal research, and attorney review before anything is filed. We compete with the top U.S. immigration firms, not with the paperwork mills. If that's the standard you want to build a team around, keep reading.


This is a role for someone who has real mileage and knows how to develop people. It is not an entry-level position. We're looking for someone with genuine U.S. immigration experience — comfortable both in the dynamics of immigration court and in assembling complex USCIS petitions — with the maturity to lead, train, and hold a team accountable.


What you'll do

  • Lead the paralegal team — assign cases, track the caseload, enforce deadlines, and make sure nothing is left loose
  • Train and develop the paralegals on both sides of the practice: affirmative immigration (USCIS) and removal defense (EOIR)
  • Review the team's technical work (QA) — petitions, evidence packages, forms, and letters — before final attorney review
  • Standardize processes, checklists, and SOPs to keep quality and technical consistency high across every case
  • Directly handle and supervise the most complex cases (EOIR + USCIS), serving as the team's reference point
  • Draft and review declarations, memoranda, and responses to RFEs/NOIDs in clear, well-supported legal English
  • Set and enforce an English-first standard across the team's work product and internal communication
  • Report directly to the attorney on caseload status and team development, with disciplined management in Zoho (CRM + Projects)
Note: this role is not client-facing. Your focus is the team, technical quality, and training — you work with the team and the attorney, not on the front line with clients.

Requirements (the bar is high and it doesn't drop)

  • ~5 years of U.S. immigration experience — ideally spanning both immigration court (EOIR) and USCIS petitions, Federal court is highly desirable bonus.
  • Experience leading, training, or supervising paralegals or a technical team (even informally — we want to see that you've developed people and raised a team's standard)
  • Fluent English — written and spoken — is essential and non-negotiable. You'll review and train legal-English work product and set the team's English standard.
  • Spanish is a strong plus — a Spanish-speaker can also take on Spanish-language cases directly, which adds real value to the role. Portuguese is a nice bonus but not required.
  • Command of the core USCIS forms and processes (I-130, I-485, I-765, N-400, I-589, visa petitions) and familiarity with removal-proceeding dynamics
  • Absolute rigor with deadlines, organization, and ownership that doesn't get passed off
  • Able to work 100% remote on U.S. business hours (Washington, DC time zone) , following the U.S. calendar

What we offer

  • Direct contract , 100% remote from Latin America, in a leadership role
  • Payment in U.S. dollars (USD) , monthly — commensurate with experience
  • Real investment in you: training, mentorship, top-tier systems and technology to operate at the level of a first-rate firm
  • A grown-up, respectful, process-driven environment — no micromanagement, with clarity and structure
  • We hire for talent, not pedigree. If you're excellent and bigger firms overlooked you, you're exactly who we want to talk to.
