title: Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Travel Buddies

Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen.


Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür.


Was du machst

Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns:


Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus.


Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per WhatsApp, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst.


Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden.


Was du mitbringen musst

  • Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen.
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch.
  • Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per WhatsApp und im Video-Call.


Was zusätzlich hilft

  • Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse
  • Englisch fließend
  • Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung
  • Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen
  • Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business
  • Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im Amazonas


Was wir bieten

  • Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt.
  • Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen.
  • Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen.
  • Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst.
  • Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.

    • Eine Frage in deiner Bewerbung: Welchen Ort oder welche Begegnung in Brasilien könntest du möglich machen, die ein Tourist allein nie findet?

title: Controller de Projetos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Controller de Projetos em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1.Controlar a esteira de entregas dos projetos e demandas, garantindo o correto avanço dos pacotes de tarefas entre as equipes envolvidas.

2.Receber, organizar e validar as informações dos pacotes de tarefas, incluindo escopo, responsáveis, prazos, dependências e critérios de aprovação.

3.Consolidar as estimativas de horas/homem informadas pelas equipes, analisando sua coerência com o escopo e a complexidade da demanda.

4.Apoiar a composição e revisão do orçamento dos projetos, considerando alterações de escopo, esforço, prazos e impactos financeiros.

5.Controlar a aprovação dos pacotes de tarefas e liberar as atividades aprovadas para as próximas equipes da esteira.

6.Acompanhar o andamento dos projetos e pacotes de tarefas, monitorando prazos, responsáveis, pendências, gargalos e desvios.

7.Garantir que as etapas da esteira avancem somente após o cumprimento dos critérios de aprovação, documentação e aceite estabelecidos.

8.Identificar riscos, atrasos, retrabalhos, inconsistências e bloqueios, acionando as áreas responsáveis para tratativas e ajustes necessários.

9.Manter a rastreabilidade das informações, aprovações, premissas, liberações, entregas e decisões relacionadas aos projetos.

10.Consolidar relatórios gerenciais sobre status das demandas, horas previstas e realizadas, custos estimados, pacotes em andamento, pacotes concluídos e pendências.

11.Acompanhar a aderência entre horas planejadas e horas executadas, identificando variações relevantes e apoiando a análise de suas causas.

12.Apoiar as lideranças na priorização das demandas, considerando capacidade das equipes, prazos, dependências, riscos e impacto financeiro.

13.Monitorar indicadores de performance da esteira, como cumprimento de prazos, variação de horas, tempo médio por etapa, retrabalho, pacotes pendentes e demandas bloqueadas.

14.Propor melhorias nos fluxos, controles, ferramentas e critérios de passagem entre as etapas da esteira de projetos.

15.Apoiar a gestão na tomada de decisão por meio de informações confiáveis sobre esforço, custo, prazo, capacidade e andamento dos projetos.

title: VEXOS Platform Manager (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para VEXOS Platform Manager (Remote) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're Hiring | VEXOS Platform Manager

Remote · Full-Time | Based in Brazil


The Render Pros is the presales creative engine behind some of the most ambitious real estate developments in the world. We build photorealistic visualizations, immersive digital experiences, and VEXOS — our proprietary presales platform that transforms how developers market and sell high-value assets before they're built.


We're growing and we need a sharp, reliable operator to help us run VEXOS smoothly.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


About The Render Pros / VEXOS


We are a vertically integrated presales studio. Our clients are real estate developers, luxury asset companies, and investment groups working on projects across the Western hemisphere. VEXOS is our platform product — a fully branded, data-driven presales environment that combines 3D visualization, buyer engagement tools, and lead intelligence. We define the strategy. You help us execute it.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


The Role


The VEXOS Platform Manager supports the delivery and day-to-day management of VEXOS client deployments. You will work closely with our Visualization PMs, development team, and founder to keep projects on track and clients well-supported.


You are organized, communicative, and detail-oriented. You follow process, flag issues early, and represent the platform professionally to clients. You execute the vision — you don't set it.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


✅ What You'll Be Responsible For


• Coordinating VEXOS project timelines alongside the Visualization PM

• Scheduling and running client onboarding and training calls using provided materials

• Managing client communication after delivery — answering questions, logging change requests, and escalating issues to the right internal person

• Keeping project trackers, onboarding checklists, and documentation up to date

• Following established delivery SOPs and flagging when something is off-track

• Supporting the creation of training materials, guides, and client-facing documentation as directed

• Being the day-to-day client contact for active VEXOS accounts


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


What We're Looking For


Experience

• 2–4 years in a client-facing coordination, account support, or digital project management role

• Experience working with SaaS platforms, creative tech, or digital products is a plus

• Background in real estate or luxury industries is a bonus, not a requirement


Skills

• Exceptional written and spoken English — you will be communicating with US-based executive clients daily

• Comfortable learning and navigating new software platforms quickly

• Able to explain digital tools clearly to non-technical users

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail

• Responsive, professional, and calm under pressure

• Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift


Mindset

• You follow through. Every time.

• You communicate proactively — you don't go quiet when things get complicated

• You take pride in representing a premium brand to premium clients

• You're here to execute at a high level and grow with the company


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


🛠 Tools You'll Work With


VEXOS platform (proprietary) · Notion or Asana · Zoom · Google Workspace · Loom


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


What We Offer


• Competitive salary in USD

• 100% remote — work from Brazil or Mexico

• Direct day-to-day collaboration with the founder

• A stable, long-term role in a growing company

• Opportunity to grow into greater responsibility as VEXOS scales


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


How to Apply


Send your CV and a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) covering:

1. Who you are and what you've managed

2. Why this role interests you

3. One example of how you handled a difficult client situation

title: Lead Demand & Supply Planning S&OP (SAP)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Demand & Supply Planning S&OP (SAP) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a highly experienced SAP Plan-to-Deliver (P2D) Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) Consultant to join our team. As a senior consultant, you will be responsible for designing and implementing integrated S&OP solutions in SAP S/4HANA, leading demand and supply planning workshops , and providing business consulting and analysis expertise to drive business transformation .

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design: Design SAP S/4HANA S&OP solutions and define demand planning, supply planning, and inventory optimization processes. Business Analysis: Lead S&OP business workshops, elicit planning requirements, and document As-Is/To-Be processes across demand and supply functions. System Integration: Align planning processes with production, procurement, and sales; ensure integration across supply chain and finance. Implementation & Configuration: Configure SAP IBP/APO/S&OP solutions, set up forecasting models, and enable scenario planning and simulations. Project Leadership: Define scope and timelines for S&OP workstreams and coordinate data integration. Performance Optimization: Improve forecast accuracy, optimize inventory and service levels, and leverage analytics for decision support.

✅ Job Requirements

8+ years of SAP ECC and S/4HANA planning solution experience. Expertise in SAP IBP, APO, and S&OP configuration. Deep knowledge of demand/supply planning, forecasting models, and inventory optimization. Proven manufacturing experience (Required). Automotive industry experience is a strong plus. 1–2 full lifecycle implementations. Advanced/Fluent English language skills are mandatory. Business consulting experience, with a demonstrated track record of acting as a Business Consultant or Business Analyst in SAP transformation programs.

title: SAP IBP & S&OP Solution Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SAP IBP & S&OP Solution Architect em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SAP IBP & S&OP Solution Architect


  • Location: Brazil - Remote
  • Employment type: Full-time contractor
  • Compensation: Up to USD 7,500 per month


About Us

LDH by Stefanini is part of Stefanini Group, a global technology company delivering digital transformation, IT consulting, and nearshore talent solutions for enterprise clients across North America and Latin America.


About the Role

We are looking for a senior SAP IBP & S&OP Solution Architect to support a strategic SAP planning and transformation project for a global enterprise client in the automotive manufacturing industry.

The role is ideal for a hands-on SAP planning consultant or architect who can operate between business and technology, lead business conversations, translate planning needs into SAP solutions, and support the implementation of scalable planning processes in a manufacturing environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design SAP S/4HANA and SAP IBP solutions for Sales & Operations Planning.
  • Lead S&OP workshops with stakeholders across supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, sales, and finance.
  • Gather requirements and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications.
  • Document As-Is and To-Be processes, gap analysis, and solution recommendations.
  • Configure and support SAP IBP, SAP APO, and related S&OP planning capabilities.
  • Support demand planning, supply planning, forecasting, inventory optimization, scenario planning, simulations, and analytics.
  • Ensure integration between planning processes and production, procurement, sales, inventory, and finance.
  • Present findings, risks, and recommendations to senior business and IT stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and SAP planning solutions.
  • Strong experience with SAP IBP, SAP APO, and S&OP processes.
  • Deep knowledge of demand planning, supply planning, forecasting, and inventory optimization.
  • Proven experience in manufacturing environments.
  • Experience with SAP implementation, rollout, or transformation projects.
  • Strong business consulting or business analyst experience within SAP programs.
  • Ability to lead workshops, gather requirements, perform gap analysis, and create business-facing documentation.
  • Experience working with international or U.S.-based stakeholders.


Nice to Have

  • Automotive industry experience.
  • SAP S/4HANA transformation experience.
  • Full lifecycle SAP implementation experience.
  • Experience with global templates, multi-country rollouts, or large enterprise environments.
  • Strong executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Familiarity with North American business culture and delivery expectations.


Why Join Us?

  • Work with a global technology organization on enterprise SAP transformation initiatives.
  • Support a strategic planning project in a complex manufacturing environment.
  • Collaborate with international stakeholders.
  • Contribute to high-impact SAP S/4HANA, IBP, APO, and S&OP work.

description:

Ready to shape the future of work?

At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change—we drive it. AI and digital innovation are redefining industries, and we’re leading the charge. Responsibilities


Master Data Operations

  • Manage day‑to‑day master data operations, ensuring timely and accurate execution of assigned tasks.
  • Maintain vendor, material, and service master records (creation, updates, modifications, deletions) in alignment with SLA requirements across multiple regions.
  • Perform data cleaning, enrichment, and standardization activities to improve overall data quality.


Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with global governance requirements and internal sourcing policies, including ethics, environmental stewardship, social responsibility, localization, and health & safety standards.
  • Collaborate with internal and external audit teams, preparing documentation, evidence, and supporting materials to address findings and implement recommended actions.


Vendor Management

  • Drive centralized vendor management by maintaining accurate records, consistent classification, and risk validation.
  • Establish and monitor vendor accounts, including non‑preferred vendor listings, to ensure compliance and sustainability reporting.
  • Provide ongoing maintenance and enrichment of vendor data to support continuous improvement.


Continuous Improvement & Systems Support

Track, measure, and implement continuous improvement initiatives related to master data processes.

  • Coordinate with UAT teams to support testing, validation, and deployment of system or process changes.
  • Prepare operational and analytical reports, and support automation of recurring tasks.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Respond to client and supplier queries, providing timely and effective resolutions within stipulated timeframes.
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams to ensure smooth delivery of master data services and alignment with business needs.


Qualifications we seek in you!

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Master Data Management & planning, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment of material, service, & vendor master records
  • Strong knowledge of data governance and data quality practices, including cleansing and standardization in large‑scale ERP environments.
  • Industry experience in mining, manufacturing, or heavy industry preferred.
  • Expertise in material and vendor master data, with familiarity in MDM tools (e.g., SAP MDG, Informatica).
  • Comprehensive understanding of procurement and supply chain processes, with emphasis on master data governance.


Technical / Functional Competencies

  • Proficiency in SAP MM, Excel, & data analysis tools
  • Knowledge of UNSPSC, ISO standards, and material classification systems
  • Hands‑on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle), including workflow processes
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage.
  • Understanding of governance methodologies to ensure accuracy, consistency, and resilience across material, service, and vendor records.


General Competencies

  • Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder‑management skills
  • Effective time management and ability to anticipate needs and drive outcomes
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills to resolve complex data or process issues
  • Critical thinking and analytical acumen for root‑cause analysis and continuous improvement
  • Self‑starter with a proactive, “can‑do” attitude, adaptable to evolving business needs.



Why join Genpact?

• Be a transformation leader – Work at the cutting edge of AI, automation, and digital innovation

• Make an impact – Drive change for global enterprises and solve business challenges that matter

• Accelerate your career – Get hands-on experience, mentorship, and continuous learning opportunities

• Work with the best – Join 140,000+ bold thinkers and problem-solvers who push boundaries every day

• Thrive in a values-driven culture – Our courage, curiosity, and incisiveness - built on a foundation of integrity and inclusion - allow your ideas to fuel progress

Come join the tech shapers and growth makers at Genpact and take your career in the only direction that matters: Up.

Let’s build tomorrow together.

  • Vivência com modernização de aplicações e arquiteturas cloud-native e serverless;

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Designer de Apresentações (Pleno/Sênior) - Banco de talentos em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Estamos em busca de um Designer de Apresentações com forte experiência em criação de layouts, templates e narrativas visuais, capaz de seguir guidelines de marca com excelência estética e transformar conteúdos complexos, incluindo materiais médicos e científicos, em apresentações claras, estratégicas e visualmente atraentes. Procuramos um profissional com domínio de Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, olhar apurado para hierarquia visual, acessibilidade e storytelling, habilidade para resolver problemas de design com agilidade e interesse constante por novas tendências e ferramentas inovadoras.

Inglês fluente é mandatório pois trabalhamos em projetos internacionais com times globais.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver apresentações estratégicas, dinâmicas e visualmente sofisticadas, garantindo consistência com as diretrizes de marca, excelência estética e adaptação para diferentes formatos e dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile);

  • Trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa com outros designers, gerenciando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e mantendo alta performance em ambientes de ritmo acelerado.

description:

About the Company


Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.


Company Website:


About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors


Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.


We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.


Key Responsibilities


  • Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network.
  • Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships.
  • Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement.
  • Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate.
  • Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Passion for football and the business of sports.
  • Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader.
  • Strong professional network that can support club growth.
  • Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.


Compensation & Benefits


This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.


Why Join Us


Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham, our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you’ve ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.


Equal Opportunity Statement


Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


Selection decisions are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and the ability to contribute to the responsibilities of the advisory role.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Editor em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Creative Video Editor - DTC Brand


Location: Fully Remote (must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. Our marketing team is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow their skills in performance marketing while building a long-term role with a mission-driven company.


The Role

You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.


What You'll Do

Video Editing & Production

  • Create high-performing Facebook/Instagram ad creatives and social media clips
  • Edit short-form content optimized for platform-specific formats
  • Source and organize B-roll and stock footage using the provided subscriptions
  • Manage creator content in Frame.io and maintain organized asset libraries

Graphic Design & Assets

  • Design marketing images, thumbnails, and social graphics
  • Create on-brand visual assets using Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Project Management

  • Track assignments and status updates in ClickUp
  • Follow naming conventions and file organization protocols
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions


Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of video editing experience, specializing in short-form content
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, color theory, composition, and motion graphics
  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication
  • Self-managed — strong time management and ability to meet daily/weekly deadlines
  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.


Nice to Have

  • Background in DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Frame.io, Notion)
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics and what makes ads convert


Tech Requirements

Computer: i7 processor (or equivalent) with 16GB RAM minimum

Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum

Schedule

Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST



Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).


🛠️ Professional Setup Access to premium stock libraries, SFX collections, motion graphics templates, and AI tools. We invest in your efficiency.


Fully Remote + Flexible Work from anywhere with reliable internet. Core overlap hours with US Eastern Time for collaboration.


🚀 High-Volume Learning Produce more ads in 6 months than most editors create in 2 years. Accelerate your skills exponentially.


Application Process:


Step 1: Submit Application

  • Current CV/resume
  • Portfolio link with 3-5 best DTC ads (Vimeo, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted)
  • Brief note (3-4 sentences) explaining which ad in your portfolio performed best and why you think it worked


Step 2: Paid Test Project ($100 USD) Top candidates receive raw footage + a creative brief to produce a 30-60 second Meta ad. Turnaround: 48 hours.


Step 3: Interview + Strategy Discussion 30-minute video call to discuss your creative process, workflow, and alignment with our brand.


Step 4: Onboarding Start with a 2-week paid trial producing live ads for our campaigns.


Applications without portfolio samples will be not be considered.


Good luck! We are excited to meet you!

title: PMO (Escritório de projetos)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para PMO (Escritório de projetos) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre o netLex


O netLex surgiu para revolucionar o mercado de Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), fazendo fluir o trabalho de todos que lidam com documentos. Acreditamos que a experiência deve ser a mais agradável possível e, por que não, divertida?!


Para alcançarmos nosso objetivo, usamos tecnologia para otimizar os processos de formalização e gestão de documentos e, ao fazermos isso, conseguimos extrair mais dados e gerar inteligência. Assim, nossos clientes ( os maiores da América Latina) podem alcançar um novo patamar de excelência e ter acesso a uma série de informações estratégicas para os ajudar a tomar decisões melhores.


Estamos crescendo os nossos times buscando novos talentos que queiram transformar o mundo da gestão do ciclo de vida de documentos com soluções inovadoras. Aqui na netLex temos uma cultura bem forte, que se baseia em um ambiente colaborativo e descontraído para nossos netLecos e netLecas!


Valorizamos a diversidade e são muito bem-vindas candidaturas de pessoas pretas, mulheres, PCD, indígenas, LGBTQIA+ ou outros grupos minorizados 🧡


Sobre a oportunidade:


Estruturar e liderar o escritório de gestão de projetos (PMO) da netLex, garantindo governança, padronização e entrega de valor nos projetos de implantação. O foco desta posição é criar uma operação de projetos eficiente e escalável, traduzindo complexidade operacional em resultados claros para clientes Enterprise e para a alta liderança, enquanto desenvolve uma cultura de projetos orientada a resultados em toda a organização.


Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades comoPMO por aqui?


Governança e Padronização

  • Definir e padronizar metodologias de gestão de projetos (Ágil, Tradicional/Preditivo ou Híbrido) em toda a organização.
  • Desenvolver modelos de documentos, relatórios, fluxos de aprovação e ferramentas obrigatórias para os gerentes de projeto.
  • Auditar projetos periodicamente para garantir conformidade com normas e critérios estabelecidos.
  • Monitorar indicadores globais de saúde do portfólio (ROI, desvio de prazo, controle de orçamento).
  • Reportar o status consolidado de todas as iniciativas para a alta liderança por meio de dashboards e relatórios executivos.

Gestão de Recursos e Riscos

  • Otimizar a alocação de profissionais, equipes e orçamentos entre projetos para evitar gargalos.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos interdependentes que afetam múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, traçando planos de contingência corporativos.
  • Intervir na resolução de conflitos por recursos entre diferentes departamentos, inclusive organizando a prática de gestão de partes interessadas, envolvendo clientes externos.

Desenvolvimento de Pessoas e Cultura

  • Treinar gerentes de projeto e lideranças táticas nas melhores práticas de mercado.
  • Promover uma cultura de eficiência, entrega de valor e foco em resultados por toda a estrutura.
  • Gerenciar, capacitar e motivar a equipe técnica e funcional, promovendo um ambiente saudável e de melhoria contínua.


Para que você seja considerado(a) para a posição, é necessário apresentar:


  • Certificação PMP (Project Management Professional) ou PMO-CP (PMO Certified Practitioner).
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (projetos globais e atendimento a clientes internacionais).
  • Forte experiência em Gestão de Projetos, PMO ou Liderança, incluindo coordenação de programas, gestão de portfólios múltiplos (PPM) e interface com C-level.
  • Experiência em sistemas no modelo SaaS.
  • Domínio de frameworks ágeis (Scrum e Kanban) e metodologias tradicionais (Waterfall).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de portfólio (Clarity PPM, Asana Enterprise ou MS Project).
  • Capacidade de Storytelling com Dados — transformar planilhas complexas em apresentações com narrativa lógica e plano de ação proposto.
  • Vivência em Change Management : análise de impacto cultural, mapeamento de stakeholders e planos de comunicação.
  • Ensino superior completo.


Nossos olhos irão brilhar, se você:


  • Espanhol avançado/fluente (diferencial para atendimento a clientes Latam).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI e criação de dashboards executivos (Power BI ou similares).
  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia de alto crescimento ou scale-ups.


O que oferecemos:


Modelo Remote First : trabalhe de onde quiser de forma remota, mas caso queira, poderá visitar nossa sede localizada no coração de Belo Horizonte;

Equipamentos de trabalho : disponibilizamos o principal que você precisa para poder trabalhar com tranquilidade;

Jornada de trabalho flexível : aqui priorizamos entregas de qualidade, e não tempo desprendido;

Cartão de benefício flexível Caju : valores mensais para você usar da forma que quiser (Refeição, alimentação, home office, mobilidade e cultura);

Plano de saúde e odontológico;

Day off de aniversário : tire um dia para curtir e relaxar em até 90 dias após seu aniversário;

Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

Gamificação em nossa plataforma de engajamento : compute netcoins que serão revertidos em prêmios a cada trimestre;

Educalex : benefício de incentivo à educação para a realização de cursos, workshops, palestras, aquisição de livros e mais!

Stock Options : possibilidade de adquirir ações da netLex de acordo com seu desenvolvimento em nosso plano de carreiras.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Video Editor em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


Location: Remote

Compensation: USD $20–30/hour

Type: Freelance contractor

Hours: Expecting 40–80 hours/month to start

Path: Potential to move into full-time within a few months


About trends.ceo


trends.ceo works with CEOs, executives, and senior leaders at high-trust firms.

Our work is not generic corporate video or random social clips. We help serious leaders turn their best ideas, experience, and perspective into sharp editorial video that feels credible, modern, and worth watching.

The work sits between documentary, executive communications, and premium social video. It requires strong storytelling, clean taste, and the ability to make complex business ideas feel clear and compelling.

We’re looking for a senior editor who can help us raise the creative standard.


The role


You’ll edit executive interviews and leadership content into polished short-form and mid-form videos for a business audience.

This role is for someone with strong creative direction and editorial sense. We need an editor who understands what footage to include, when to use it, how to shape pacing, where sound design matters, and how to make senior leaders look credible, natural, and engaging.


Responsibilities


Edit executive interviews into high-quality short-form and mid-form videos.

Find strong hooks, story arcs, insights, and human moments in raw footage.

Shape complex business topics into clear, compelling edits.

Make smart choices on b-roll, cutaways, pacing, music, sound design, captions, graphics, and text treatment.

Use AI tools where helpful to storyboard ideas, create simple animations, generate visual references, or support lightweight visual concepts.

Maintain a premium, modern, editorial visual style.

Work with our creative team to apply feedback quickly.

Stay organized, meet deadlines, and manage project files properly.


What we’re looking for


5+ years of professional video editing experience.

A strong portfolio with relevant interview, documentary, corporate, editorial, or premium social samples.

Excellent storytelling instincts.

Strong taste in pacing, structure, music, sound design, and visual polish.

Experience editing business, executive, documentary, or high-end interview content.

Advanced Adobe Premiere Pro skills.

After Effects and AI tools are a strong plus.

Comfort using AI tools as part of the creative process.

Strong English comprehension.

Reliable, organized, and comfortable working remotely.

What matters most


You can find the story inside the footage.

You know the difference between a generic clip and a strong idea.

You understand when to use b-roll, when to stay on the speaker, and when the edit needs breathing room.

You can make senior people look sharp without making the work feel overproduced.

You bring creative opinions, not just technical execution.

Application process


Please send:

Your portfolio or 3–5 relevant video samples.

A short note on your experience editing interviews or executive/business content.

Your hourly rate.

Your monthly availability.

Selected candidates will be invited to complete a paid editing test .

title: PMO (Escritório de projetos)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para PMO (Escritório de projetos) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre o netLex


O netLex surgiu para revolucionar o mercado de Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), fazendo fluir o trabalho de todos que lidam com documentos. Acreditamos que a experiência deve ser a mais agradável possível e, por que não, divertida?!


Para alcançarmos nosso objetivo, usamos tecnologia para otimizar os processos de formalização e gestão de documentos e, ao fazermos isso, conseguimos extrair mais dados e gerar inteligência. Assim, nossos clientes ( os maiores da América Latina) podem alcançar um novo patamar de excelência e ter acesso a uma série de informações estratégicas para os ajudar a tomar decisões melhores.


Estamos crescendo os nossos times buscando novos talentos que queiram transformar o mundo da gestão do ciclo de vida de documentos com soluções inovadoras. Aqui na netLex temos uma cultura bem forte, que se baseia em um ambiente colaborativo e descontraído para nossos netLecos e netLecas!


Valorizamos a diversidade e são muito bem-vindas candidaturas de pessoas pretas, mulheres, PCD, indígenas, LGBTQIA+ ou outros grupos minorizados 🧡


Sobre a oportunidade:


Estruturar e liderar o escritório de gestão de projetos (PMO) da netLex, garantindo governança, padronização e entrega de valor nos projetos de implantação. O foco desta posição é criar uma operação de projetos eficiente e escalável, traduzindo complexidade operacional em resultados claros para clientes Enterprise e para a alta liderança, enquanto desenvolve uma cultura de projetos orientada a resultados em toda a organização.


Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades comoPMO por aqui?


Governança e Padronização

  • Definir e padronizar metodologias de gestão de projetos (Ágil, Tradicional/Preditivo ou Híbrido) em toda a organização.
  • Desenvolver modelos de documentos, relatórios, fluxos de aprovação e ferramentas obrigatórias para os gerentes de projeto.
  • Auditar projetos periodicamente para garantir conformidade com normas e critérios estabelecidos.
  • Monitorar indicadores globais de saúde do portfólio (ROI, desvio de prazo, controle de orçamento).
  • Reportar o status consolidado de todas as iniciativas para a alta liderança por meio de dashboards e relatórios executivos.

Gestão de Recursos e Riscos

  • Otimizar a alocação de profissionais, equipes e orçamentos entre projetos para evitar gargalos.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos interdependentes que afetam múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, traçando planos de contingência corporativos.
  • Intervir na resolução de conflitos por recursos entre diferentes departamentos, inclusive organizando a prática de gestão de partes interessadas, envolvendo clientes externos.

Desenvolvimento de Pessoas e Cultura

  • Treinar gerentes de projeto e lideranças táticas nas melhores práticas de mercado.
  • Promover uma cultura de eficiência, entrega de valor e foco em resultados por toda a estrutura.
  • Gerenciar, capacitar e motivar a equipe técnica e funcional, promovendo um ambiente saudável e de melhoria contínua.


Para que você seja considerado(a) para a posição, é necessário apresentar:


  • Certificação PMP (Project Management Professional) ou PMO-CP (PMO Certified Practitioner).
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (projetos globais e atendimento a clientes internacionais).
  • Forte experiência em Gestão de Projetos, PMO ou Liderança, incluindo coordenação de programas, gestão de portfólios múltiplos (PPM) e interface com C-level.
  • Experiência em sistemas no modelo SaaS.
  • Domínio de frameworks ágeis (Scrum e Kanban) e metodologias tradicionais (Waterfall).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de portfólio (Clarity PPM, Asana Enterprise ou MS Project).
  • Capacidade de Storytelling com Dados — transformar planilhas complexas em apresentações com narrativa lógica e plano de ação proposto.
  • Vivência em Change Management : análise de impacto cultural, mapeamento de stakeholders e planos de comunicação.
  • Ensino superior completo.


Nossos olhos irão brilhar, se você:


  • Espanhol avançado/fluente (diferencial para atendimento a clientes Latam).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI e criação de dashboards executivos (Power BI ou similares).
  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia de alto crescimento ou scale-ups.


O que oferecemos:


Modelo Remote First : trabalhe de onde quiser de forma remota, mas caso queira, poderá visitar nossa sede localizada no coração de Belo Horizonte;

Equipamentos de trabalho : disponibilizamos o principal que você precisa para poder trabalhar com tranquilidade;

Jornada de trabalho flexível : aqui priorizamos entregas de qualidade, e não tempo desprendido;

Cartão de benefício flexível Caju : valores mensais para você usar da forma que quiser (Refeição, alimentação, home office, mobilidade e cultura);

Plano de saúde e odontológico;

Day off de aniversário : tire um dia para curtir e relaxar em até 90 dias após seu aniversário;

Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

Gamificação em nossa plataforma de engajamento : compute netcoins que serão revertidos em prêmios a cada trimestre;

Educalex : benefício de incentivo à educação para a realização de cursos, workshops, palestras, aquisição de livros e mais!

Stock Options : possibilidade de adquirir ações da netLex de acordo com seu desenvolvimento em nosso plano de carreiras.

  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written.

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

We are seeking a Project Manager to serve as the operational backbone of client delivery, coordinating workflows across creative, media, and retention teams. You will be responsible for managing project timelines, organizing resources, and ensuring seamless communication between internal teams and clients to maintain the high standard of service our partners expect.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of client deliverables and campaign launches
  • Streamlined workflows that eliminate bottlenecks and improve team velocity
  • High client satisfaction scores through proactive communication and organized project management
  • Well-documented processes that scale efficiently as the team and client base grow


Responsibilities

  • Manage project timelines and deliverables across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Coordinate between creative, media buying, retention, and account teams to allocate resources effectively
  • Organize weekly client meeting agendas, take detailed notes, and create actionable task lists from meeting outcomes
  • Create and assign Asana tasks for internal teams based on client requests and monthly retainer deliverables
  • Track creative production pipelines and monitor asset status from brief through completion
  • Build and maintain SOPs for internal processes, organized in Notion
  • Set up and manage client project management tools including Google Drive, Asana, Slack, and creative proofing platforms
  • Lead internal team standups and coordinate cross-functional project kickoffs
  • Handle client onboarding processes and schedule kick-off calls with appropriate stakeholders
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks and proactively implement process improvements
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of scope of work for each client account
  • Keep all project stakeholders aligned and informed to ensure client retention and satisfaction


Requirements

  • 4+ years of project management experience in a digital marketing or agency environment
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through
  • Familiarity with eCommerce platforms and digital advertising (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, email marketing)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with clients and internal teams
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Expert proficiency with Google Drive (Docs, Sheets, Slides)
  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools (Asana, Notion, Slack)
  • Ability to work independently while fostering collaborative team relationships


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a digital advertising or eCommerce agency
  • Familiarity with creative production workflows and asset management
  • Experience with Figma, Frame.io, or other creative collaboration tools
  • Background in managing subscription-based or retainer client relationships
  • Process documentation and SOP development experience


Compensation and Benefits

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan : Fully customizable 401(k) with up to 4% company match
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage : Fully-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Wellness Benefits : Complimentary Headspace subscription and fitness stipend
  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Technology Supplied : Equipped with the latest laptop and necessary tools for success
  • Professional Development : Opportunities for growth, training, and expanded responsibilities
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience

title: Country Manager- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Country Manager- Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi


At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.


Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.


Position Overview

VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Brazil to lead the company's Brazilian operations and serve as the statutory executive responsible for the local VASP entity.

Reporting directly to the Global Executive Leadership Team, the CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, regulatory engagement, commercial growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. This individual will play a critical role in establishing the company's presence in Brazil, leading local market expansion, fostering relationships with regulators and financial institutions, and ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements.


The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership.


Location

Remote – Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.


Key Responsibilities

Executive Leadership

  • Lead the overall strategy, growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil.
  • Build and develop the local leadership team and organizational structure.
  • Establish operational excellence while ensuring alignment with global company objectives.
  • Drive execution across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Product functions.

Regulatory & Corporate Governance

  • Serve as the primary executive representative before Brazilian regulatory authorities.
  • Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) , financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders.
  • Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives.

Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships

  • Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil.
  • Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners.
  • Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth.
  • Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams.
  • Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America.
  • Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions.

Organizational Development

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field.
  • MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries.
  • Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment.
  • Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology.
  • Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil.
  • Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers.
  • Experience working within multinational or global organizations.
  • Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure.
  • Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives.


Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.


Why Join VelaFi?

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement.

Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments.


Guided by our values of Ingenuity, Accountability, Excellence, Care, and a Global Mindset , we empower our leaders to solve meaningful challenges, take ownership, and build lasting impact across global financial markets.


Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Contracting Manager, Activities Bank, Travel Industry
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Contracting Manager, Activities Bank, Travel Industry em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Manager – Activities


About Us

At HBX Group , we are a global TravelTech ecosystem connecting and empowering businesses across the world of travel. Through data, innovation, and strong partnerships, we deliver seamless experiences and help our partners grow.

Within our Activities division, we focus on building competitive, high-quality product portfolios that meet evolving market demands. Our teams operate in a fast-paced, data-driven environment where ownership, adaptability, and collaboration are key to success.


Job Summary

As a Contract Manager , you will be responsible for managing and optimizing a portfolio of suppliers, ensuring the product remains competitive, available, and aligned with market needs.

This role combines supplier relationship management, negotiation, reporting, and operational execution , with a strong focus on performance tracking, prioritization, and continuous improvement . You will work closely with internal teams and external partners to drive revenue, maintain product quality, and unlock growth opportunities.


Job Responsibilities

Supplier & Portfolio Management

  • Manage a portfolio of Activities suppliers, ensuring product availability and competitiveness at all times.
  • Maintain and develop strong relationships with suppliers, acting as the main point of contact.
  • Ensure existing products remain optimized and aligned with market expectations.


Contracting & Negotiation

  • Negotiate commercial conditions including rates, inventory, offers, and contract terms.
  • Ensure renewal contracts are competitive and available in time to capture demand.
  • Benchmark competitors and proactively renegotiate where needed to maintain market positioning.


Performance Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze portfolio performance through bi-weekly reports and statistics , identifying trends and opportunities.
  • Monitor KPIs and take actions to improve conversion, revenue, and product performance.
  • Provide insights and explanations on portfolio performance using data and market knowledge.


Operational Excellence

  • Manage multiple processes simultaneously, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and quality.
  • Prioritize tasks effectively based on business impact and deadlines.
  • Maintain updated product content (rates, inclusions, descriptions, availability).
  • Solve operational issues and coordinate solutions with internal teams and suppliers.


Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Sales, Operations, Revenue, Product teams).
  • Support cross-functional initiatives and ensure alignment on commercial priorities.
  • Represent HBX Group in supplier meetings and market visits.


Required Skills

  • Strong prioritization and time management , with the ability to manage multiple processes simultaneously.
  • High level of analytical thinking , comfortable working with reports, data, and performance metrics.
  • Strong commercial mindset with negotiation capabilities.
  • Excellent relationship management and communication skills .
  • High attention to detail and process discipline, with flexibility to manage changing priorities.
  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently.


Required Tech Skills

  • Intermediate Excel skills (data analysis, reporting, tracking KPIs).
  • Experience working with internal systems, contracting tools, or booking platforms .
  • Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actions.
  • Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards is a plus.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 1–3+ years of experience in contracting, sourcing, account management, or similar roles.
  • Experience in travel, tourism, or supplier management is highly preferred.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese for communication with global teams.
  • Availability to travel as part of supplier relationship management.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

description:

We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.


What you’ll do:

• Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

• Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content

• Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

• Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

• Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

• Analyze performance and double down on what works


Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting
  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips
2. Podcast Clip Strategy
  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan
  • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where
  • Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)
3. Growth & Optimization
  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks
  • Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:
  • Views
  • Engagement
  • Follower growth
  • A/B test captions, formats, and posting times
4. Platform Expertise
  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms
  • Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)
5. Systems & Organization
  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system
  • Track posted content and performance metrics
  • Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting
6. Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • Editors (to refine clips)
  • Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)
  • Leadership (to align on growth strategy)


What we’re looking for:

• Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

• Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

• Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior

• Ability to manage both content output + community interaction

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)
  • Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing. 
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack
  • Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)
  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients
Bonus:

• Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

• Background in content editing or scripting

• Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

description:

Buscamos um(a) Formatador(a) de E-books para transformar o conteúdo textual (entregue em Word, já revisado, com infográficos e imagens) em material didático visual completo, formatado em PowerPoint e exportado em PDF, seguindo o sistema de identidade visual definido em manual.
