title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Functional Business Consultant (with Infor WMS experience)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Functional Business Consultant (with Infor WMS experience) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for an experienced Functional Business Consultant (with Infor WMS experience) to support us with WMS Integration and Implementation projects, Audits and Consulting projects.


Innovecs is a global digital transformation tech company with a presence in the US, the UK, the EU, Israel, Australia, and Ukraine. Specializing in software solutions, the Innovecs team has experience in Supply Chain, Healthtech, Software & Hightech, and Gaming.

For the fifth year in a row, Innovecs is included in the Inc. 5000 and recognized in IAOP’s ranking of the best global outsourcing service providers. Innovecs is featured in the Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces Ranking and won gold at the Employer Brand Management Awards.


Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience in functional and business analysis ; preferably supporting and/or configuring Warehouse Management Systems (WMS);
  • Hands-on experience with Infor WMS (must);
  • Experience in Supply Chain , Warehousing, Logistics, or 3PL operations (must);
  • Understanding of warehouse processes including receiving, putaway, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, and inventory management;
  • Experience onboarding customers and supporting production environments;
  • Experience performing WMS system configuration and minor functional enhancements;
  • Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills;
  • Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into system configuration changes;
  • Experience creating and maintaining functional documentation and training materials;
  • Ability to communicate effectively with warehouse operators, customer stakeholders, and technical teams;
  • Working knowledge of SQL is a plus;
  • Experience with Transportation Management Systems (TMS) is a strong plus;
  • Understanding of 3PL operational processes and customer implementations is a strong plus;
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and customer-oriented mindset;
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced support environment;
  • Advanced or native English .



Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a primary functional support contact for Infor WMS customers;
  • Support onboarding and implementation of new customers onto the WMS platform;
  • Conduct customer discovery sessions to understand operational requirements and warehouse processes;
  • Configure WMS settings and perform minor system adjustments based on approved business requirements;
  • Troubleshoot functional issues, investigate root causes, and coordinate resolution with technical teams when required;
  • Perform gap analysis between customer requirements and existing WMS functionality;
  • Create and maintain configuration documentation, process flows, user guides, and support materials;
  • Assist with testing activities, including system validation, regression testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT);
  • Deliver end-user and operational training for warehouse personnel and customer teams;
  • Support customer go-live activities and provide post-implementation hypercare support;
  • Monitor support tickets, prioritise customer issues, and ensure timely resolution;
  • Work closely with operations, implementation, and development teams to improve system performance and customer experience;
  • Recommend process improvements and optimisation opportunities within warehouse operations and WMS configuration;
  • Maintain strong understanding of Infor WMS best practices and emerging Supply Chain technology trends;
  • Act as a subject matter expert for Infor WMS configuration and warehouse operational workflows.


  • Nice-to-have: Experience with TMS integrations, EDI processes, 3PL multi-customer warehouse environments, and warehouse automation solutions.

title: Field-Programmable Gate Arrays Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Field-Programmable Gate Arrays Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior FPGA Engineer – Quantum Products & Solutions

Role is based in Abu Dhabi - WILL REQUIRE RELOCATION


This Senior FPGA Engineer role is building next-generation quantum sensing hardware


  • Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE - Full Relocation supported.
  • Salary: Competitive, DOE – 110-130K+ Euro equivalent + amazing benefits & relocation + Private Education allowance for families + x2 First month salary + free flights out and home + private healthcare & Dental for you and family etc etc.
  • Job Type: Permanent - (Visa for you / Spouse)


About the Business

A well-funded and R&D group (Been around for 10yrs+ & 1000+ team)... developing next-generation quantum technology for real-world applications.


About the Role

The role spans applications including magnetic sensing and inertial navigation, working closely with physicists, embedded systems engineers, and software engineers to turn scientific requirements into robust hardware.


You'll take a lead role on timing closure, verification, and technical direction, + oversight of outsourced FPGA development.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Architect, design, and implement FPGA-based digital hardware for quantum sensing platforms & systems.
  • Develop and maintain RTL designs in VHDL/Verilog for real-time signal acquisition, processing, and control
  • Lead hardware/software co-design, interfacing FPGAs with ADCs/DACs, high-speed serial links, and embedded processors
  • Implement and optimise high-speed data pipelines (filtering, triggering, DSP chains) within FPGA fabric
  • Lead timing closure, resource optimisation, and verification of FPGA designs, including simulation and hardware-in-the-loop test
  • Develop and maintain testbenches and verification worlds.
  • Supervise outsourced FPGA development and contribute to technical reviews
  • Prepare technical documentation including design specs, test reports, and user manuals
  • Debug, validate, and optimise performance using lab equipment (oscilloscope, logic analyser, spectrum analyser)
  • Participate in laboratory and field testing of integrated systems


What We're Looking For

Essential:

  • Strong proficiency in VHDL and/or Verilog for FPGA design
  • Experience with major FPGA toolchains (Xilinx Vivado, Intel/Altera Quartus)
  • Experience with high-speed interfaces (JESD204B/C, SerDes, DDR memory controllers)
  • Strong understanding of timing closure, clock domain crossing, and resource optimisation
  • Experience interfacing FPGAs with ADCs/DACs and analogue frontends
  • Familiarity with communication protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, PCIe)
  • Experience with hardware bring-up, debugging, and validation
  • Proficiency with version control (Git, SVN)
  • Experience with simulation/verification tools (ModelSim, QuestaSim) and testbench development
  • Experience with scripting (Python, Tcl) for design automation and test
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to work across physics, electronics, and software disciplines
  • Degree (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
  • 5+ years' relevant experience in FPGA or digital hardware design, ideally within R&D or sensing


Desirable:

  • Experience with soft-core processors (MicroBlaze, NIOS II) and FPGA/SoC platforms (Xilinx Zynq)
  • Experience with High-Level Synthesis (HLS)
  • Experience with schematics, PCB-level considerations, and signal integrity
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for hardware/firmware validation


What's On Offer

  • Fully supported relocation to Abu Dhabi, including one month's hotel accommodation and food on arrival
  • First month's salary doubled to help with relocation costs
  • Education allowance of AED 30,000 per child, per year (ages 2-18)
  • Annual flights home for you and your family
  • 25 days annual leave plus 12 public holidays
  • Private healthcare and dental cover for you and your family
  • Free lunch provided onsite daily


If this sounds like the right move for you, to do something really interesting with a really nice and diverse team of engineers that love to collabrate and drive new technology....


We have helped over 300+ engineers relocate and have made this career move smooth and easy and support any questions and information required to ensure you feel comfortable with this exciting move.

  • Job Type: Permanent - (Visa for you / Spouse)


About the Business

A well-funded and R&D group (Been around for 10yrs+ & 1000+ team)... developing next-generation quantum technology for real-world applications.


About the Role

The role spans applications including magnetic sensing and inertial navigation, working closely with physicists, embedded systems engineers, and software engineers to turn scientific requirements into robust hardware.


You'll take a lead role on timing closure, verification, and technical direction, + oversight of outsourced FPGA development.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Architect, design, and implement FPGA-based digital hardware for quantum sensing platforms & systems.
  • Develop and maintain RTL designs in VHDL/Verilog for real-time signal acquisition, processing, and control
  • Lead hardware/software co-design, interfacing FPGAs with ADCs/DACs, high-speed serial links, and embedded processors
  • Implement and optimise high-speed data pipelines (filtering, triggering, DSP chains) within FPGA fabric
  • Lead timing closure, resource optimisation, and verification of FPGA designs, including simulation and hardware-in-the-loop test
  • Develop and maintain testbenches and verification worlds.
  • Supervise outsourced FPGA development and contribute to technical reviews
  • Prepare technical documentation including design specs, test reports, and user manuals
  • Debug, validate, and optimise performance using lab equipment (oscilloscope, logic analyser, spectrum analyser)
  • Participate in laboratory and field testing of integrated systems


What We're Looking For

Essential:

  • Strong proficiency in VHDL and/or Verilog for FPGA design
  • Experience with major FPGA toolchains (Xilinx Vivado, Intel/Altera Quartus)
  • Experience with high-speed interfaces (JESD204B/C, SerDes, DDR memory controllers)
  • Strong understanding of timing closure, clock domain crossing, and resource optimisation
  • Experience interfacing FPGAs with ADCs/DACs and analogue frontends
  • Familiarity with communication protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, PCIe)
  • Experience with hardware bring-up, debugging, and validation
  • Proficiency with version control (Git, SVN)
  • Experience with simulation/verification tools (ModelSim, QuestaSim) and testbench development
  • Experience with scripting (Python, Tcl) for design automation and test
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to work across physics, electronics, and software disciplines
  • Degree (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
  • 5+ years' relevant experience in FPGA or digital hardware design, ideally within R&D or sensing


Desirable:

  • Experience with soft-core processors (MicroBlaze, NIOS II) and FPGA/SoC platforms (Xilinx Zynq)
  • Experience with High-Level Synthesis (HLS)
  • Experience with schematics, PCB-level considerations, and signal integrity
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for hardware/firmware validation


What's On Offer

  • Fully supported relocation to Abu Dhabi, including one month's hotel accommodation and food on arrival
  • First month's salary doubled to help with relocation costs
  • Education allowance of AED 30,000 per child, per year (ages 2-18)
  • Annual flights home for you and your family
  • 25 days annual leave plus 12 public holidays
  • Private healthcare and dental cover for you and your family
  • Free lunch provided onsite daily


If this sounds like the right move for you, to do something really interesting with a really nice and diverse team of engineers that love to collabrate and drive new technology....


We have helped over 300+ engineers relocate and have made this career move smooth and easy and support any questions and information required to ensure you feel comfortable with this exciting move.

We're hiring a detail-oriented, numbers-driven Vacation Rental Revenue Manager to help Emperor Rentals improve pricing, occupancy, and revenue across our short-term rental portfolio.

title: Data Annotator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Annotator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.
  • 12 Month Contract
  • Fully Remote in LATAM
  • Hourly Rate: $5-7USD - Salary will be paid out in Local currency
  • 40/hrs work per week
  • Candidates need to be willing to work PST Time


Required Skills & Experience:


Must Haves:

  • Bachelor’s Degree. Open major, provided the academic background demonstrates high-level critical thinking, synthesis, and reading comprehension (e.g., Translation, Law, Psychology, Marketing, or Humanities).
  • C1 (Advanced) or C2 (Mastery) English fluency.
  • 3-4 months of data annotation or LLM evaluation experience (Textual data annotation preferred)
  • Proficiency in reading comprehension and possessive of strong writing skills, with the ability to understand and interpret complex and diverse texts.
  • Ability to work independently, follow instructions, manage time effectively, and meet deadlines in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to manage ambiguity, uncertainty, and changing priorities with limited resources.
  • Ability to accept and integrate continuous feedback while remaining professional.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate within a multi-disciplinary team.
  • Quick learner and self-starter with strong problem-solving skills.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience:


  • Plusses:
  • Experience w RLHF (Reinforcement Learning Human Feedback)
  • Multiple Language proficiency
  • Experience with multi modal data annotation (Text, Image, Video)
  • QA or QC experience


Job Description:


Their day to day includes accurately labeling machine learning textual data to refine AI models. This will primarily involve annotating large volumes of textual data according to predefined guidelines. This person must be able to read, write and summarize at a high volume and high accuracy. The Pre-screening tests typing speed (45-60wpm), reading comprehension and pattern recognition. Finding those who are sharp and can navigate ambiguous technical jargon would be a great fit for the role.


Day to Day Responsibilities


Accurately label machine learning data through various methods to refine AI models. This will primarily involve annotating large volumes of textual data according to predefined guidelines.

Collaborate with team members to identify improvements to the labelling interface or labelling processes in order to drive efficiency and high-quality.

Complete assignments by deadlines while meeting team expectations and goals.

title: Head of Compliance (Brazil resident)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance (Brazil resident) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.


Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Head of Compliance on the ground. The authorisation itself depends on having someone the BCB trusts in this seat — someone who treats AML/CFT, KYC, and disclosure as the actual job, not paperwork around it. In your first year, you will have stood up the compliance program the regulator expects to see and built the company's track record with the BCB from zero.


What you'll do

  • Hold statutory officer responsibility for compliance at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Own the design and effectiveness of the AML/CFT and KYC program, including transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and suspicious activity reporting
  • Act as the primary point of contact with the BCB and COAF for compliance matters, including audits, inspections, and ad hoc information requests
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the compliance workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline


What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship, with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing officer or director seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • Direct compliance experience at a BCB-regulated institution (bank, securities broker/distributor, foreign exchange dealer) or at a crypto exchange/VASP
  • Hands-on ownership of AML/CFT and KYC programs, not just oversight of someone else's
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires


Nice-to-have

  • Prior compliance experience specifically within a crypto exchange or VASP
  • AML/compliance certification (e.g. CAMS, ICA)
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB or COAF on audits, inspections, or filings

title: Presales Solution Architect, OSS
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Presales Solution Architect, OSS em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the lead OSS solution architect across the full pre-sales lifecycle – from opportunity qualification and technical discovery through proof-of-concept, proposal, and contract award – partnering closely with Sales leadership to shape, qualify, and grow the regional pipeline.
  • Own and orchestrate end-to-end responses to RFx (RFI / RFP / RFQ), including solution design, compliance and traceability matrices, win themes, technical narratives, effort and Bill-of-Materials estimation, assumptions, and risk identification – driving on-time, high-quality, fully compliant submissions.
  • Design and articulate end-to-end OSS solution architectures spanning Service Assurance, Service Orchestration & Fulfilment, Inventory, and closed-loop automation, mapping the Rakuten Symphony portfolio to operator pain points and measurable business outcomes.
  • Position and demonstrate the Service Assurance portfolio – fault, performance, and service-quality management; AI/ML-driven anomaly detection, alarm correlation and noise reduction; automated root-cause analysis; and predictive, proactive assurance – including customer-experience and network-slice assurance for 5G Standalone.
  • Develop solutions, value cases, and demonstrations around SMO (Service Management & Orchestration) and RIC (RAN Intelligent Controller) platforms, including the Non-RT RIC and rApps (R1, A1 interfaces) and the Near-RT RIC and xApps (E2 interface), addressing use cases such as RAN energy savings, traffic steering, QoE optimization, massive-MIMO and interference management, and anomaly detection.
  • Champion network automation and autonomy – closed-loop operations, intent-based and intent-driven management, and the journey toward TM Forum Level 4 autonomous networks – and translate these capabilities into concrete, quantifiable value propositions for customers.
  • Lead technical proofs-of-concept, lab trials, product demonstrations, and solution integration and validation, tailoring demo environments to each customer’s specific use cases, KPIs, and success criteria.
  • Be responsible and accountable for authoring technical solution documents, high-level designs, design proposals, sizing and Bill-of-Materials, and TCO / ROI models that withstand customer and third-party technical scrutiny.
  • Serve as the trusted technical advisor to customers and prospects – running discovery workshops, executive briefings, and technical deep-dives – and manage technical stakeholder relationships from engineering and operations teams up to C-level.
  • Work cross-functionally with internal teams – Product Management, Engineering, Delivery / Professional Services, Commercial, and Bid Management – and with external parties – operators, system integrators, hyperscalers, and O-RAN / ecosystem partners – to assemble winning and deliverable solutions.
  • Generate thought-leadership content – white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and webinars – and represent Rakuten Symphony at industry events and standards / community forums such as TM Forum and the O-RAN ALLIANCE.
  • Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer conversations and internal strategy.


Requirements:

Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise:

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.
  • Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx responses and customer-facing technical engagements.
  • Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Service Assurance domain – fault, performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management, and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance).
  • Strong working knowledge of network automation and autonomy – closed-loop assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5).
  • Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management interfaces.
  • Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment models.
  • Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines, telemetry, and data lakes).
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate virtual, cross-functional bid and solution teams across multiple geographies and time zones, and to manage internal and external stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel as required.

We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and the creator community to identify opportunities, validate ideas, and ensure our product solves real user problems. Your understanding of short-form video trends, creator workflows, and AI-powered content creation will directly influence our product roadmap.


What You’ll Do

  • Become a power user of Vmake’s AI video tools by testing new features, identifying usability issues, and evaluating the overall creator experience.
  • Analyze user behavior, creator feedback, and product metrics to uncover opportunities for product improvements.
  • Monitor trends across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, and emerging creator platforms, translating market insights into actionable product recommendations.
  • Partner with Product Managers to define product requirements, prioritize enhancements, and support roadmap planning.
  • Conduct competitive research on AI-powered creative tools and video editing platforms, identifying best practices and product gaps.
  • Gather, organize, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative user feedback into clear product recommendations.
  • Collaborate closely with Design and Engineering teams throughout feature discovery, testing, and iteration.
  • Assist in defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance after launch.
  • Create documentation including product briefs, user stories, competitive analyses, and feature specifications.


Who You Are

  • 3–5 years of experience in Product, Product Analysis, Product Operations, or a related product role within SaaS, AI, creator economy, social media, or e-commerce technology.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian creator ecosystem and short-form video platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and enthusiasm for generative AI technologies.
  • Experience translating customer pain points into clear product requirements.
  • Strong analytical thinking with the ability to interpret both qualitative and quantitative data.
  • Excellent communication skills and experience working cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Engineering.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with changing priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Active content creator with a public portfolio or social media presence.
  • Experience with TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, or creator-focused commerce platforms.
  • Experience conducting user interviews, usability testing, or product discovery.
  • Familiarity with wireframing tools such as Figma.
  • Experience using analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, or similar platforms.

title: Vacation Rental Revenue Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vacation Rental Revenue Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're hiring a detail-oriented, numbers-driven Vacation Rental Revenue Manager to help Emperor Rentals improve pricing, occupancy, and revenue across our short-term rental portfolio.


This is a fully remote position for candidates currently based in Brazil. You'll work with property performance data, market trends, and pricing tools to help us make smarter revenue decisions every week.


Compensation:

$250 USD per week, paid weekly.


What you'll do:

- Review property performance, pricing, occupancy, ADR, and revenue trends

- Help optimize nightly rates based on seasonality, demand, events, and competitor pricing

- Build and maintain simple revenue reports and forecasts

- Track KPIs and identify opportunities to increase profitability

- Support pricing decisions across Airbnb, short-term rental, and vacation rental channels

- Communicate insights clearly and help the team make data-backed decisions


You may be a great fit if you:

- Are currently based in Brazil and can work remotely

- Are highly analytical, organized, and comfortable working with numbers

- Have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Can spot patterns in data and turn them into practical recommendations

- Are detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive

- Communicate clearly and can work independently

- Are interested in hospitality, Airbnb, short-term rentals, real estate, finance, or revenue management


Nice to have:

- Experience with Airbnb, vacation rentals, hotels, property management, or revenue management

- Experience with pricing tools, market research, dashboards, or financial reporting

- Background in business, finance, economics, analytics, hospitality, or a related field


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys data, pricing strategy, and helping a growing vacation rental company make smarter decisions. If you're based in Brazil and want a remote role where your analysis directly affects business results, we'd love to hear from you.


To apply, please include:

- Your resume

- A short note about your relevant experience

- Your LinkedIn profile, if available

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

What will you do as a Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner at Sealed Air?


As a Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner at Sealed Air, you will collaborate closely with HR Partners and Business Leaders to identify critical hiring needs and build a strong pipeline of passive candidates. You will manage and coordinate all candidate communications, including screening, feedback, and onboarding, ensuring a seamless and positive experience. Additionally, you will take full ownership of the recruiting process, from requisition approval to onboarding, optimizing efficiency and alignment with business goals. This role will also focus on enhancing the candidate experience while supporting hiring managers in making informed talent decisions. Ultimately, you will contribute to Sealed Air’s success by attracting and securing top talent that is aligned with our strategic objectives.


Why do we need you?


· Develop a strong understanding of Sealed Air’s business, competitive landscape, and overall strategy to enhance business partnerships and recruiting effectiveness.

· Attend trade shows and networking events to build and maintain a robust external network, fostering partnerships that generate a pipeline of key talent for current and future hiring needs.

· Support and collaboratively drive the development and implementation of innovative strategies to attract and assess top talent.

· Leverage all direct recruitment channels, including internal and external job resources, social media, employee referral programs, lead generation sources, alumni networks, professional associations, conferences, and industry events.

· Take ownership of the recruiting process, ensuring a seamless and positive experience for candidates and hiring managers from requisition approval to onboarding.

· Provide ongoing support to hiring managers and HR as needed.

· Conduct intake sessions with hiring managers to identify ideal candidate requirements, establish sourcing strategies, align on recruiting processes, and determine communication methods and frequency.

· Conduct phone screenings with candidates and provide structured feedback to hiring managers based on the agreed-upon communication plan.

· Present an overview of Sealed Air’s business, employee benefits, and professional development opportunities, creating a compelling vision for potential candidates.

· Arrange and facilitate interviews, collect feedback, and coordinate post-interview debriefs with hiring managers for all active positions.

· Partner with HR, Compensation, and Hiring Managers to develop and communicate competitive job offers to candidates.

· Work closely with HR and Hiring Managers to gather and provide timely post-screen and post-interview feedback to candidates.

· Maintain accurate and up-to-date hiring documentation for all requisitions, interviews, and candidates within SuccessFactors (ATS) to ensure an audit-ready posture at all times.

· Continuously improve all stages of the candidate and hiring manager experience by identifying opportunities, recommending solutions, and contributing to implementation efforts.


What do you need to succeed in this role?


· There are no education or year of experience restrictions.

Advanced level of Portuguese, Spanish and English required

· Experience with the full recruitment lifecycle.

· Knowledge by covering positions in whatever of the business units below, would be great:

· Supply Chain

· Corporate Functions

· Commercial

· Agile in Microsoft Office.

· Experience in Success Factors

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

As an Accounting Analyst, you’ll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You’ll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our finance and operations departments.


You’ll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of our financial records, preparing key financial statements, and supporting the business with timely and data-driven reporting. This role requires a proactive approach, a strong grasp of Brazilian tax regulations, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws (SPED, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, etc.).
  • Prepare and analyze financial statements (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial, Fluxo de Caixa).
  • Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations.
  • Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures.
  • Prepare and analyze the company’s accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency.
  • Develop accounting reports to support decision-making.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS).
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings.
  • Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil.
  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Are proficient in accounting software — knowledge of Odoo is a plus.
  • Excel in advanced Excel skills and familiarity with financial analysis tools.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering reliable financial information.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Third Interview: A conversation with our CFO to align on technical expectations and ensure you're the right fit for our finance team.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media 🚀


We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.

With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!


Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! title: Immigration Case Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Immigration Case Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Busca-se profissional altamente detalhista para atuar como Case Manager de processos imigratórios (EB-2 NIW, EB-1A, O-1A, L-1, H-1B, Green Card por Casamento/parentesco, extensões e trocas de status).


Esta oportunidade é remota (do Brasil), em tempo integral e envolve gestão de equipes , forte processamento de dados, gestão de processos, atuação em redação e revisão estratégica de petições e cartas persuasivas em inglês, análise documental, e interação direta com clientes.


Requisitos :

  • Fluência em inglês .
  • 2+ anos de experiência em gerenciamento de equipes.
  • 2+ anos de experiência direta com imigração americana , redigindo e conduzindo ponta a ponta casos de EB-2 NIW e EB-1A com excelência.
  • Experiência prática com Asilo, Vistos U e T, VAWA e EOIR será considerada um diferencial .
  • Excelente gestão de processos e análise documental.
  • Fortes habilidades de liderança e comunicação com cliente.
  • Excelente planejamento orçamentário para alocação eficiente de pessoas e recursos financeiros.
  • Capacidade de priorizar diferentes tarefas e coordenar o trabalho de outros.
  • Alto nível de julgamento independente.
  • Habilidades no uso de Google Suite, Microsoft Office, Excel e Adobe PDF.
  • Excelente gerenciamento de tempo para cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos.


Liderança, organização, atenção aos detalhes e proatividade são essenciais para esta posição. O profissional deve possuir excelente comunicação oral e escrita em inglês e português, capacidade para definir estratégias, redigir petições e cartas imigratórias persuasivas, gerenciar equipes e projetos e garantir o cumprimento de prazos e objetivos.


Responsabilidades :

  • Supervisionar a equipe de paralegals, gerenciando o volume e a alocação de trabalho para garantir prazos.
  • Revisar documentos confeccionados pela equipe de paralegals, fornecendo feedbacks construtivos para o desenvolvimento da equipe.
  • Contactar clientes de forma independente e manter comunicação ativa para garantir o progresso dos casos.
  • Implementar e monitorar processos internos para melhorias constantes.
  • Revisar e preparar formulários de imigração e documentação, assegurando precisão e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Coordenar fornecedores externos para serviços como Business Plan, Expert Opinion Letter, traduções e equivalências acadêmicas.
  • Redigir petições imigratórias minuciosamente detalhadas e organizadas com excelente fundamentação fática-legal.
  • Monitorar o Visa Bulletin e os prazos dos processos.
  • Examinar documentos, alinhar estratégias com a equipe e realizar pesquisas, com foco no Administrative Appeals Office (AAO) da USCIS.
  • Formular estratégias de imigração personalizadas para cada cliente.
  • Manter a equipe atualizada sobre leis e políticas imigratórias dos EUA.
  • Garantir registros precisos e organizados das interações com clientes e arquivos.
  • Realizar acompanhamentos regulares com a equipe e com clientes conforme necessário.

title: Engenheiro de IA Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de IA Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para assumir a manutenção e a evolução contínua do Plataforma Agents de IA — nosso framework de orquestração de agentes de IA

que automatiza ciclos completos de desenvolvimento de software (refinement → dev →security → QA → deploy) em nossos projetos reais, em produção.


Esta não é uma vaga de \"treinar modelo\" nem de \"fazer prompt em chatbot\". E engenharia de plataforma com foco em confiabilidade, observabilidade e auto-recuperação de agentes autônomos rodando 24/7 em produção, escrevendo código de desenvolvimento, fazendo git push, abrindo PRs, mergeando em omolog, fazendo cherry-pick para produção.


O que é o Plataforma Agents de IA

Para você decidir se a vaga te interessa, precisa entender o que vai manter:


• Orquestrador: Le as issues (Jira), identifica issues prontas pra cada stage, dispara

agentes (Claude/OpenIA/Gemini/DeepSeek) com contexto rico, valida o resultado, posta

comentario na issue, e avanca o status. Roda em servidores Linux, com auto-update.

• Agentes (@dev, @qa, @sec, @devops, @pm, @po, @sm, @analyst, @architect, @data-engineer, @ux-design-expert): cada um com persona, authority matrix definida, skills executáveis e Gates de qualidade.

• Rules: Mais de 60 regras formais que governam o comportamento dos agentes — desde naming conventions até anti-hallucination validation em 7 camadas. Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent.

• Recovery loops: quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota.

• Multi-repo via submodules: projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar.

• Stack: Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.js/TypeScript (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq,

integrações HTTP com Jira/GitHub via curl + retry policy.


O que você vai fazer


Manutenção do core (40%)

• Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade

ciclomática.

• Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem

determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário.

• Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento.

• Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue).

• Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta \"agent crashou em loop\", \"PR criado no repo errado\", \"deploy não promoveu\") e fechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva.


Evolução de agents e rules (35%)

• Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist).

• Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho.

• Manter o agent-authority.md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex: @dev

ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146).

• Criar/refatorar skills.

• Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B).


Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%)

• Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, OpenAI CLI, Gemini CLI, DeepSeek direct).

• Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex:

DeepSeek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação).

• Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve.

• Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient;

expandir cobertura).

• Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection —

entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria.


O que esperamos de você


Stack técnica — obrigatório

• Bash/Shell avançado e Linux — você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de

bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs,

parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de ((

e porque importa.

• Node.js / TypeScript — escreve TS com strict mode, entende quando não usar Node

(ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS).

• Git e GitHub avançado — cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr

create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução

de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, GitHub Actions workflows.

• Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos — você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que \"diga ao modelo o que não fazer\" raramente funciona, entende o

efeito de exemplos few-shot vs zero-shot, e já debugou ao menos uma vez porque um agente está \"alucinando\" um PR que não criou.


Experiência

• 5+ anos de engenharia de software produzindo sistemas em produção.

• Pelo menos 1 ano com agentes autônomos / orquestração de LLMs em ambiente

real (não bootcamp, não side project) — você sabe a diferença entre \"rodou no demo\" e \"rodou em prod 24/7 sem humano\".

• Histórico comprovado de manter sistemas legados com debt técnico — você não quer \"reescrever do zero\".

• Inglês técnico fluente para leitura/escrita (documentação, issues, comentários de código em inglês obrigatórios; comunicação verbal pode ser PT/EN/ZH dependendo do time).


Mentalidade

• Determinismo > magia. Você prefere uma regex feia em bash que sempre funciona a um ML model elegante que falha em 5% dos casos. Em orquestração de agentes, 5% de falha = produto inviável.

• Forensics sobre intuição. Antes de propor solução, você lê o log, o diff, a issue real do cliente. Não inventa hipótese.

• Documentação executável. Quando você cria uma rule nova, ela tem detector regex que pode rodar em CI. \"Documentei em texto\" não basta.

• Empatia por agente. Você consegue ler um prompt de 8k tokens e identificar onde o modelo vai se confundir, por que, e o que ajustar.


Diferenciais

• Experiencia com Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph ou frameworks de orquestração equivalentes.

• Já implementou ou manteve sistemas de retry policy + backoff exponencial + circuit breaker em integrações com APIs externas instáveis.

• Já trabalhou com monorepos via submodules (nao apenas Nx/Turborepo) e entende

os trade-offs.

• Contribuições open-source em projetos relacionados (CLIs, dev tooling, agent

frameworks).

• Experiencia com DevOps em servidores Linux dedicados (não apenas k8s/cloud managed): systemd, cron, logrotate, monitoring com ferramentas leves.

• Familiaridade com conventional commits, semantic-release, gitflow trifásico

(feature → homolog → main com cherry-pick).

• Já escreveu post-mortem público / case study técnico que outras pessoas referenciam.


Benefícios

• Assistência Odontológica – Bradesco

• Programa de Orientação Pessoal – C4Life

• Day Off de Aniversário

title: Head of Risk (Crypto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Risk (Crypto) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based)


About the Company:

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it.


The Role:

We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity.


This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth.


Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake.


We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment.


What You'll Do:

  • Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk.
  • Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy.
  • Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities.
  • Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making.
  • Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks.
  • Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies.
  • Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation.
  • Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve.


What We're Looking For:

  • 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls.
  • Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives.
  • Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them.
  • Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level.
  • Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk.
  • Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers.
  • Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector.
  • Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Analista (a) SAP BW Hana - Remoto
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista (a) SAP BW Hana - Remoto em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


The SAP BW Lead will be responsible for leading end to end SAP BW initiatives, including architecture, design, development, migration, and operational support across SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA landscapes. The role will also own real time and near real time data replication using SAP SLT, ensure performant analytics leveraging Native HANA modeling, and act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.

This is a hands on leadership role requiring deep technical expertise as well as team and delivery ownership.


Key Responsibilities:


Advanced English


• Lead design and implementation of SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA solutions including modeling, data acquisition, transformations, and reporting layers.


• Define and govern BW architecture standards, object reuse strategy, naming conventions, transport strategy, and performance benchmarks.


• Own delivery across implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support engagements.

Data Acquisition & Integration (SLT Focus)


• Design and manage real time and delta data replication from SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA to BW using SAP SLT.


• Ensure optimal data flow design covering ODP, SLT, and standard extractors, with reconciliation and monitoring frameworks.


• Work closely with Basis and source system teams to ensure stable and scalable replication setups.


SAP BW Modeling & Transformations:


o InfoObjects, ADSOs (Field based & InfoObject based)


o Composite Providers, Open ODS Views


o Transformations, DTPs, Process Chains


Design and optimize Native HANA objects, including:


o Calculation Views, Table Functions, SQL Script procedures

o CDS Views (where applicable)

• Leverage push down logic to HANA to improve query and load performance.


• Collaborate with BW and HANA teams to decide optimal BW vs Native HANA modeling strategy.


Reporting & Analytics:


Oversee reporting solutions using:


o BEx Queries / Analysis for Office / SAP BO / SAC (where applicable)


• Ensure reporting performance, semantic consistency, and business KPI alignment across domains (FI, CO, SD, MM, Supply Chain).


Migration & Modernization:


Lead BW on HANA / BW/4HANA conversion and migration programs, including:


o Readiness checks and simplification item handling


o Remediation of custom code and data models


o Data volume management and performance validation


• Support S/4HANA transformation programs from an analytics perspective.

Production Support & Governance

• Act as escalation point for production issues, SLA adherence, root cause analysis, and resolution.

• Ensure strong governance around transports (ChaRM), releases, incident/change management, and documentation.


Team & Stakeholder Leadership:


• Mentor and guide SAP BW developers and HANA modelers.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, architects, and program managers.

• Contribute to effort estimation, planning, and delivery commitments.

Remote: Brazil - Remote

Full time


About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. Our Compliance team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to manage conduct risk.

We’re looking for a Regulatory Compliance Manager to keep our consumer protection practice in compliance. You‘ll advise on crypto compliance requirements and related controls.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

  • Developing and executing a world-class compliance framework, monitoring, and training programme

  • Drafting, implementing, and rolling out compliance plans, frameworks, and policies
  • Providing expert regulatory advice to the Operations teams to support product launches
  • Collaborating with international product teams to navigate cross-border compliance requirements
  • Supporting the Head of Compliance in rolling out a robust compliance programme


What you'll need

  • 4+ years of experience advising on compliance-related matters
  • The ability to analyse and interpret data to guide regulatory strategy
  • A solid understanding of the interplay between compliance risk and business risk
  • The ability to communicate positively with regulators and members of various internal teams
  • Excellent analytical skills with a proven track record of learning complex, new regulations quickly
  • Fluency in English

title: Senior Immigration Paralegal
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Immigration Paralegal em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Immigration Paralegal


Team Lead & Trainer — Remote — EOIR + USCIS + Federal Litigation (Bonus)


Cunha Law PLLC — a U.S. immigration law firm based in Washington, DC — is hiring a senior immigration paralegal to lead and train our paralegal team. This is a technical leadership and team-development role : you'll be the person who trains our paralegals, reviews the team's work, and makes sure every case leaves the office at the firm's standard — across both immigration court (EOIR / removal defense) and affirmative filings before USCIS.


We are not an immigration consultancy, and we don't compete with form-fillers. Every case at Cunha Law is handled as a real legal matter — eligibility analysis, case strategy, legal research, and attorney review before anything is filed. We compete with the top U.S. immigration firms, not with the paperwork mills. If that's the standard you want to build a team around, keep reading.


This is a role for someone who has real mileage and knows how to develop people. It is not an entry-level position. We're looking for someone with genuine U.S. immigration experience — comfortable both in the dynamics of immigration court and in assembling complex USCIS petitions — with the maturity to lead, train, and hold a team accountable.


What you'll do

  • Lead the paralegal team — assign cases, track the caseload, enforce deadlines, and make sure nothing is left loose
  • Train and develop the paralegals on both sides of the practice: affirmative immigration (USCIS) and removal defense (EOIR)
  • Review the team's technical work (QA) — petitions, evidence packages, forms, and letters — before final attorney review
  • Standardize processes, checklists, and SOPs to keep quality and technical consistency high across every case
  • Directly handle and supervise the most complex cases (EOIR + USCIS), serving as the team's reference point
  • Draft and review declarations, memoranda, and responses to RFEs/NOIDs in clear, well-supported legal English
  • Set and enforce an English-first standard across the team's work product and internal communication
  • Report directly to the attorney on caseload status and team development, with disciplined management in Zoho (CRM + Projects)
Note: this role is not client-facing. Your focus is the team, technical quality, and training — you work with the team and the attorney, not on the front line with clients.

Requirements (the bar is high and it doesn't drop)

  • ~5 years of U.S. immigration experience — ideally spanning both immigration court (EOIR) and USCIS petitions, Federal court is highly desirable bonus.
  • Experience leading, training, or supervising paralegals or a technical team (even informally — we want to see that you've developed people and raised a team's standard)
  • Fluent English — written and spoken — is essential and non-negotiable. You'll review and train legal-English work product and set the team's English standard.
  • Spanish is a strong plus — a Spanish-speaker can also take on Spanish-language cases directly, which adds real value to the role. Portuguese is a nice bonus but not required.
  • Command of the core USCIS forms and processes (I-130, I-485, I-765, N-400, I-589, visa petitions) and familiarity with removal-proceeding dynamics
  • Absolute rigor with deadlines, organization, and ownership that doesn't get passed off
  • Able to work 100% remote on U.S. business hours (Washington, DC time zone) , following the U.S. calendar

What we offer

  • Direct contract , 100% remote from Latin America, in a leadership role
  • Payment in U.S. dollars (USD) , monthly — commensurate with experience
  • Real investment in you: training, mentorship, top-tier systems and technology to operate at the level of a first-rate firm
  • A grown-up, respectful, process-driven environment — no micromanagement, with clarity and structure
  • We hire for talent, not pedigree. If you're excellent and bigger firms overlooked you, you're exactly who we want to talk to.

description:

Esta não é uma vaga CLT. É uma parceria.

O mercado está migrando da remuneração por produto para a consultoria fee-based. Cada vez mais consultores querem operar assim, mas esbarram na estrutura que isso exige: research, alocação, back-office, compliance, tecnologia e custódia rodando ao mesmo tempo.

Bankers que já atendem clientes e querem escalar.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Online Ad Rater - Remote Work for German Speakers in Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Seeking a freelance project that will allow you to work from home while making a difference in the world of technology? If you are someone who is passionate and enjoys staying ahead of the tech curve this part-time remote project with flexible working hours might be what you are looking for!


A Day in the Life of a Personalized Internet Ads Assessor:

  • In this role, you will be reviewing online advertisements by rating them on their relevance to the search terms used as well as providing feedback on their language and cultural relevance in order to improve their content, quality, and layout
  • Your ultimate goal will be to contribute towards making internet search and online advertising more relevant and interesting for millions of users, including yourself.



Join our team today and start putting your skills to work for one of the world's leading online advertising platforms while being a part of a supportive community that offers:

  • Access to complimentary mental health support benefits like free EAP and Mindfulness Apps.
  • Dedicated, responsive well-being team proactively offering well-being education each month, as well as quarterly initiatives.



TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.


Qualification path

No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part-time long-term project and your work will be subject to our standard quality assurance checks during the term of this agreement.


Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills, with full professional proficiency in English and Geman
  • Having familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media, and cultural affairs in Brazil
  • Active use of Gmail, Google+, and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Daily access to a broadband internet connection, a smartphone (Android 4.1, iOS 8 or higher), and a personal computer with antivirus software to work on. You’ll also need a
  • Barcode Scanner application to be installed on your smartphone to complete certain tasks.
  • English CV
  • This is an explicit human evaluation role. Live task rating requires authentic human judgment, perspective, and evaluation


The estimated hourly earnings for this role is 6 USD. Payment is based on completed tasks, with the potential for higher earnings based on productivity.


Assessment

In order to be hired into the program, you’ll take a language assessment and an open book qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Don’t worry, our team will provide you with guidelines and learning materials before your exam. You will be required to complete the exam in a specific timeframe but at your convenience!


Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategic Customer Success Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.

You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.


Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.


How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.


Join Client!

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Lead Demand & Supply Planning S&OP (SAP)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Demand & Supply Planning S&OP (SAP) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a highly experienced SAP Plan-to-Deliver (P2D) Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) Consultant to join our team. As a senior consultant, you will be responsible for designing and implementing integrated S&OP solutions in SAP S/4HANA, leading demand and supply planning workshops , and providing business consulting and analysis expertise to drive business transformation .

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design: Design SAP S/4HANA S&OP solutions and define demand planning, supply planning, and inventory optimization processes. Business Analysis: Lead S&OP business workshops, elicit planning requirements, and document As-Is/To-Be processes across demand and supply functions. System Integration: Align planning processes with production, procurement, and sales; ensure integration across supply chain and finance. Implementation & Configuration: Configure SAP IBP/APO/S&OP solutions, set up forecasting models, and enable scenario planning and simulations. Project Leadership: Define scope and timelines for S&OP workstreams and coordinate data integration. Performance Optimization: Improve forecast accuracy, optimize inventory and service levels, and leverage analytics for decision support.

✅ Job Requirements

8+ years of SAP ECC and S/4HANA planning solution experience. Expertise in SAP IBP, APO, and S&OP configuration. Deep knowledge of demand/supply planning, forecasting models, and inventory optimization. Proven manufacturing experience (Required). Automotive industry experience is a strong plus. 1–2 full lifecycle implementations. Advanced/Fluent English language skills are mandatory. Business consulting experience, with a demonstrated track record of acting as a Business Consultant or Business Analyst in SAP transformation programs.
