title: SR Arquiteto de Soluções SAP
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SR Arquiteto de Soluções SAP em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Aqui na Zallpy, tecnologia nasce de pessoas curiosas, colaborativas e com vontade de fazer bem feito. Se você gosta de ambientes onde existe espaço para perguntar, testar, aprender e evoluir junto, se liga nessa oportunidade!

Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão

Na Zallpy, valorizamos um ambiente onde todas as pessoas possam ser quem são, com respeito, segurança e pertencimento. Incentivamos especialmente a candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e garantimos um ambiente acessível, com adaptações e suporte ao longo da jornada.

Também encorajamos pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTQIA+ e profissionais de diferentes origens a se candidatarem.

Aqui, você pode ser quem é, em cada fase da sua jornada. Vem com a gente. 🚀

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar em um time que pensa grande, trabalha com atenção aos detalhes, parceria no dia a dia e responsabilidade compartilhada. Acreditamos em autonomia, troca entre diferentes experiências e soluções construídas em conjunto.

Por aqui, crescer significa compartilhar conhecimento, respeitar diferentes formas de pensar e construir relações de confiança enquanto entregamos tecnologia de qualidade.

Se você se identifica com esse jeito de trabalhar, vem somar com a gente.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar a definição da arquitetura funcional e técnica de soluções SAP end-to-end, envolvendo múltiplos módulos e integrações.
  • Atuar na concepção de soluções para projetos de implementação, evolução e migração para SAP S/4HANA.
  • Apoiar processos de pré-venda, contribuindo na elaboração de propostas técnicas, definição de soluções e estimativas de esforço.
  • Definir estratégias de integração entre ambientes SAP, sistemas legados e demais aplicações corporativas.
  • Avaliar impactos de mudanças, garantindo aderência à arquitetura corporativa e às melhores práticas do ecossistema SAP.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para equipes de desenvolvimento, consultoria funcional e gestão de projetos.
  • Conduzir a estratégia de Clean Core em ambientes SAP S/4HANA, promovendo soluções sustentáveis e escaláveis.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio, como Financeiro, Operações, Manufatura, Supply Chain e Comercial, traduzindo necessidades em soluções de arquitetura.


O que estamos buscando:

  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura de soluções SAP.
  • Vivência como Arquiteto de Soluções SAP, Arquiteto Corporativo, Especialista SAP ou Líder de Arquitetura.
  • Participação em projetos de implementação, transformação ou migração para SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência em processos de pré-venda e desenho de soluções do ecossistema SAP.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado dos processos de negócio, especialmente Financeiro, Compras, Vendas e Produção.
  • Experiência com arquitetura de integração entre soluções SAP e sistemas corporativos.
  • Conhecimento das metodologias de implementação SAP (Activate ou similares).
  • Vivência em ambientes complexos, multiempresas e de grande porte.
  • Capacidade de atuar junto a executivos, stakeholders de negócio e equipes multidisciplinares.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Possuir inglês avançado.
  • Ter experiência com SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP Fiori, SAP BTP e SAP Integration Suite.
  • Possuir visão funcional integrada dos módulos FI, MM e SD.
  • Ter experiência com estratégias de Clean Core e arquitetura orientada a boas práticas SAP.
  • Ser capaz de orquestrar especialistas técnicos e funcionais na construção de soluções de arquitetura.
  • Possuir certificações atualizadas em SAP relacionadas à arquitetura, SAP S/4HANA ou SAP BTP.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Functional Business Consultant (with Infor WMS experience)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Functional Business Consultant (with Infor WMS experience) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for an experienced Functional Business Consultant (with Infor WMS experience) to support us with WMS Integration and Implementation projects, Audits and Consulting projects.


Innovecs is a global digital transformation tech company with a presence in the US, the UK, the EU, Israel, Australia, and Ukraine. Specializing in software solutions, the Innovecs team has experience in Supply Chain, Healthtech, Software & Hightech, and Gaming.

For the fifth year in a row, Innovecs is included in the Inc. 5000 and recognized in IAOP’s ranking of the best global outsourcing service providers. Innovecs is featured in the Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces Ranking and won gold at the Employer Brand Management Awards.


Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience in functional and business analysis ; preferably supporting and/or configuring Warehouse Management Systems (WMS);
  • Hands-on experience with Infor WMS (must);
  • Experience in Supply Chain , Warehousing, Logistics, or 3PL operations (must);
  • Understanding of warehouse processes including receiving, putaway, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, and inventory management;
  • Experience onboarding customers and supporting production environments;
  • Experience performing WMS system configuration and minor functional enhancements;
  • Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills;
  • Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into system configuration changes;
  • Experience creating and maintaining functional documentation and training materials;
  • Ability to communicate effectively with warehouse operators, customer stakeholders, and technical teams;
  • Working knowledge of SQL is a plus;
  • Experience with Transportation Management Systems (TMS) is a strong plus;
  • Understanding of 3PL operational processes and customer implementations is a strong plus;
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and customer-oriented mindset;
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced support environment;
  • Advanced or native English .



Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a primary functional support contact for Infor WMS customers;
  • Support onboarding and implementation of new customers onto the WMS platform;
  • Conduct customer discovery sessions to understand operational requirements and warehouse processes;
  • Configure WMS settings and perform minor system adjustments based on approved business requirements;
  • Troubleshoot functional issues, investigate root causes, and coordinate resolution with technical teams when required;
  • Perform gap analysis between customer requirements and existing WMS functionality;
  • Create and maintain configuration documentation, process flows, user guides, and support materials;
  • Assist with testing activities, including system validation, regression testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT);
  • Deliver end-user and operational training for warehouse personnel and customer teams;
  • Support customer go-live activities and provide post-implementation hypercare support;
  • Monitor support tickets, prioritise customer issues, and ensure timely resolution;
  • Work closely with operations, implementation, and development teams to improve system performance and customer experience;
  • Recommend process improvements and optimisation opportunities within warehouse operations and WMS configuration;
  • Maintain strong understanding of Infor WMS best practices and emerging Supply Chain technology trends;
  • Act as a subject matter expert for Infor WMS configuration and warehouse operational workflows.


  • Nice-to-have: Experience with TMS integrations, EDI processes, 3PL multi-customer warehouse environments, and warehouse automation solutions.

title: Cloud Architect – Google Cloud (GCP)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Architect – Google Cloud (GCP) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Cloud Architect – Google Cloud (GCP) com perfil altamente técnico e vocação para ensino e evangelização.

title: Educador Físico PJ
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Educador Físico PJ em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA EDUCADOR FÍSICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Educador Físico! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar atendimentos por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Educador Físico , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Realizar orientação esportiva por vídeo e telefone com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo acolhedor, empático e resolutivo na maioria das orientações de acordo com os objetivos e dúvidas de saúde trazidos pelos beneficiários, respeitando os diferentes gêneros ou grupos etários;
  • Contatar os beneficiários através de orientações telefônicas e/ou chamada de vídeo para aplicação de anamnese esportiva, com o objetivo de identificar a familiaridade do beneficiário com a atividade física e suas limitações/ restrições de saúde bem como necessidades de melhorias nos hábitos esportivos, para realizar um treino focado e personalizado a cada indivíduo, considerando sua condição clínica, hábitos, comportamentos e objetivo do beneficiário;
  • Esclarecer dúvidas esportivas pontuais, conforme demanda trazida pelo beneficiário garantindo a sua satisfação;
  • Elaborar treinos esportivos personalizados, conforme necessidade e objetivo de cada beneficiário e posterior envio ao mesmo através de e-mail, dentro do prazo estipulado para que melhorem a sua saúde e desta forma atinjam os melhores resultados do programa;
  • Realizar acompanhamento esportivo periódico, para checar se o objetivo esperado está sendo atingido e avaliar se há necessidade de desenvolver novo material;
  • Enviar e-mail e/ou sms, whatsapp para verificar a disponibilidade de horário dos beneficiários, com o objetivo de maior assertividade nas ligações e gerar maior adesão ao programa;
  • Ter visão clínica ampla para saber quando e como solicitar suporte junto a equipe multiprofissional (nutricionista, médico e enfermagem), visando o atendimento das necessidades do beneficiário;
  • Registrar todas as orientações e informações (prestadas e coletadas) aos beneficiários e colaboradores da Teladoc Health em sistema eletrônico e/ou planilha de Excel, visando manter atualizada as bases e tratando de forma confidencial, tornando os processos seguros, éticos e legais;
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática centrada na pessoa;
  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes;
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética da Educação Esportiva, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: SUPERIOR COMPLETO EM EDUCAÇÃO FÍSICA


EXPERIÊNCIA

  • Vivência em montagem de treinos e atuação como Personal Trainer.


CONHECIMENTO ESPECÍFICOS PARA A FUNÇÃO

  • Conhecimentos e Habilidades no Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point).
  • Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


COMPETÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS

  • Capacidade investigativa;
  • Raciocínio clínico.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


*Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CREF do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em educação física.

title: VEXOS Platform Manager (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para VEXOS Platform Manager (Remote) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're Hiring | VEXOS Platform Manager

Remote · Full-Time | Based in Brazil or Mexico


The Render Pros is the presales creative engine behind some of the most ambitious real estate developments in the world. We build photorealistic visualizations, immersive digital experiences, and VEXOS — our proprietary presales platform that transforms how developers market and sell high-value assets before they're built.


We're growing and we need a sharp, reliable operator to help us run VEXOS smoothly.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


About The Render Pros / VEXOS


We are a vertically integrated presales studio. Our clients are real estate developers, luxury asset companies, and investment groups working on projects all around the western hemisphere. VEXOS is our platform product — a fully branded, data-driven presales environment that combines 3D visualization, buyer engagement tools, and lead intelligence. We define the strategy. You help us execute it.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


The Role


The VEXOS Platform Manager supports the delivery and day-to-day management of VEXOS client deployments. You will work closely with our Visualization PMs, development team, and founder to keep projects on track and clients well-supported.


You are organized, communicative, and detail-oriented. You follow process, flag issues early, and represent the platform professionally to clients. You execute the vision — you don't set it.

✅ What You'll Be Responsible For


• Coordinating VEXOS project timelines alongside the Visualization PM

• Scheduling and running client onboarding and training calls using provided materials

• Managing client communication after delivery — answering questions, logging change requests, and escalating issues to the right internal person

• Keeping project trackers, onboarding checklists, and documentation up to date

• Following established delivery SOPs and flagging when something is off-track

• Supporting the creation of training materials, guides, and client-facing documentation as directed

• Being the day-to-day client contact for active VEXOS accounts


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


What We're Looking For


Experience

• 2–4 years in a client-facing coordination, account support, or digital project management role

• Experience working with SaaS platforms, creative tech, or digital products is a plus

• Background in real estate or luxury industries is a bonus, not a requirement


Skills

• Exceptional written and spoken English — you will be communicating with US-based executive clients daily

• Comfortable learning and navigating new software platforms quickly

• Able to explain digital tools clearly to non-technical users

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail

• Responsive, professional, and calm under pressure

• Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift


Mindset

• You follow through. Every time.

• You communicate proactively — you don't go quiet when things get complicated

• You take pride in representing a premium brand to premium clients

• You're here to execute at a high level and grow with the company


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


🛠 Tools You'll Work With


VEXOS platform (proprietary) · Notion or Asana · Zoom · Google Workspace · Loom


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


What We Offer


• Competitive salary in USD

• 100% remote — work from Brazil or Mexico

• Direct day-to-day collaboration with the founder

• A stable, long-term role in a growing company

• Opportunity to grow into greater responsibility as VEXOS scales


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


How to Apply


Send your CV and a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) covering:

1. Who you are and what you've managed

2. Why this role interests you

3. One example of how you handled a difficult client situation


Applications without the Loom video will not be reviewed.

title: Voice Over Artist (Brazilian Portuguese)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Voice Over Artist (Brazilian Portuguese) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

TDLR : Pocket FM is hiring remote freelance Brazilian Portuguese Voice Over Artists with professional home studios for long-term, serialized audio fiction. The role requires native fluency and the capacity to deliver 20 to 40 hours of recorded content monthly on a per-hour paid basis.


Voice Over Artist (Brazilian Portuguese)


About Pocket FM


Pocket FM is the world’s leading audio storytelling platform, reaching over 200 million listeners across more than 20 countries. We combine human creativity and innovative technology to create immersive audio series enjoyed by millions of listeners worldwide.


As we expand our Portuguese content library, we are looking for talented, professional Brazilian Voice Over Artists to join our global network of creators.


Role Overview


As a Freelance Voice Over Artist, you will bring complex characters and gripping stories to life in serialized audio fiction. You will collaborate remotely with our production, writing, and quality teams to deliver highly engaging, emotionally authentic performances for long-form series.


This is a remote, contract-based freelance opportunity offering a consistent monthly pipeline of work for a long-term collaboration.


Requirements


  • Native Fluency: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with the ability to perform in Neutral Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Versatility & Acting Chops: Strong acting, dubbing, or storytelling skills, with the ability to portray diverse characters across a wide range of ages and emotional profiles.
  • Proven Experience: Background in voice acting, dubbing, audiobook narration, audio drama, or podcasting.
  • Studio Setup: A professional home recording studio environment with a high-quality microphone and reliable, high-speed internet.
  • Capacity: Availability to record and deliver up to 20-40 hours of recorded content per month, while maintaining weekly delivery schedules.
  • Collaboration: Openness to taking performance direction and participating in necessary retakes/feedback sessions.


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with basic audio editing and file management
  • Experience working remotely with production teams


Engagement Details

  • Contract Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote (Work from your own studio)
  • Compensation: Paid monthly on an hours delivered basis.

How to Apply : Please fill in


What happens after you apply?


Our Casting & Production Process : Here is a look at our step-by-step collaboration pipeline:

1.Internal Evaluation:

Our production team will carefully review your voice demos, studio specs, and portfolio to see if your vocal profile matches our upcoming projects.

2.Show Casting & Voice Testing:

If your profile fits, we will invite you to a voice test for the specific audio series we are casting. This helps us ensure your performance aligns perfectly with the character's vision.

3.Contract & Legal Alignment:

Once selected for a show, we will finalize a freelance legal agreement. This contract will clearly outline the voice usage rights for the series and formalize our agreed monthly payment terms.

4.Calibration & Onboarding:

Before the official recording begins, we will run a brief calibration session. This ensures your studio's audio mastering levels match our technical delivery standards for a seamless workflow.

5.Production & Monthly Deliveries:

Recording begins! Our long-form audio series typically span 150 to 300 hours in total. We partner with you for the long haul, expecting a steady delivery of 20 to 40 hours of recorded content per month until the series is complete.

Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership

Performance tuning and troubleshooting

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Risk (Crypto) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based)


About the Company:

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it.


The Role:

We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity.


This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth.


Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake.


We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment.


What You'll Do:

  • Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk.
  • Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy.
  • Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities.
  • Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making.
  • Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks.
  • Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies.
  • Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation.
  • Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve.


What We're Looking For:

  • 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls.
  • Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives.
  • Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them.
  • Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level.
  • Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk.
  • Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers.
  • Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector.
  • Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Analista de Treinamentos e Capacitação Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Treinamentos e Capacitação Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos procurando uma pessoa apaixonada por ensinar, desenvolver pessoas e construir conhecimento.

Mais do que aplicar treinamentos, buscamos alguém com vontade de criar uma área de capacitação do zero, estruturando a forma como nossos executivos e líderes aprendem, evoluem e geram resultados.

Se você gosta de comunicação, organização, criação de materiais, desenvolvimento de pessoas e deseja participar da construção de um projeto em crescimento, esta oportunidade é para você.


Missão :

Ser responsável por estruturar, desenvolver e gerenciar toda a área de treinamento e desenvolvimento da empresa, garantindo que executivos e líderes tenham acesso aos conteúdos, metodologias e materiais necessários para potencializar seus resultados. Também será responsável por organizar e preservar o conhecimento da empresa, documentando processos e transformando experiências em materiais que possam ser utilizados por toda a operação.


Requisitos :

  • Experiência com treinamentos, capacitação, educação corporativa ou desenvolvimento de pessoas.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Facilidade para falar em público.
  • Experiência na criação de apresentações utilizando PowerPoint, Canva ou ferramentas similares.
  • Organização e habilidade para documentar processos.
  • Facilidade para aprender novos assuntos e transformá-los em treinamentos.
  • Disponibilidade para ministrar treinamentos no período da noite, quando necessário


Responsabilidades

  • Planejar e conduzir treinamentos ao vivo.
  • Ministrar treinamentos online para executivos e líderes.
  • Gravar aulas e conteúdos para consulta posterior.
  • Atualizar treinamentos conforme mudanças em processos, produtos e estratégias.
  • Desenvolver trilhas de aprendizagem para diferentes níveis da operação.
  • Criar cronogramas de capacitação contínua.


Produção de conteúdo:

  • Criar apresentações para treinamentos.
  • Desenvolver manuais, guias rápidos, checklists e materiais de apoio.
  • Produzir conteúdos que facilitem o aprendizado e acelerem os resultados dos executivos.
  • Produzir materiais em texto, vídeo e apresentações.
  • Transformar processos complexos em conteúdos simples, objetivos e didáticos.


Gestão do conhecimento:

  • Estruturar e manter a central de conhecimento da empresa.
  • Documentar processos, treinamentos e boas práticas.
  • Organizar materiais para consulta rápida.
  • Garantir que o conhecimento da empresa permaneça registrado, organizado e atualizado.
  • Definir padrões para armazenamento, atualização e distribuição dos conteúdos.


Desenvolvimento da operação:

  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria na capacitação da equipe.
  • Apoiar líderes na formação de novos executivos.
  • Desenvolver treinamentos voltados para vendas, liderança, produtividade e utilização da plataforma.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de treinamento e propor melhorias contínuas.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Excelente comunicador(a).
  • Organizado(a).
  • Executor(a), com facilidade para transformar ideias em ações.
  • Criativo(a), capaz de transformar conhecimento em materiais simples e didáticos.
  • Proativo(a), identificando oportunidades sem depender de direcionamentos constantes.
  • Apaixonado(a) por ensinar e desenvolver pessoas.
  • Motivado(a) a construir algo relevante e deixar um legado dentro da empresa.
  • Aberto(a) ao aprendizado contínuo e ao crescimento junto com a operação.


Diferencial :

  • Experiência na estruturação de universidades corporativas.
  • Experiência com plataformas de aprendizagem (LMS).
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de aprendizagem e desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência em empresas dos segmentos de vendas, educação, tecnologia ou infoprodutos.
  • Experiência na gravação de videoaulas e produção de conteúdos digitais

title: Analista Funcional Jr
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista Funcional Jr em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Atividades:

  • Levantar, entender e documentar requisitos de negócio junto às áreas operacionais e clientes;
  • Elaborar Especificações Funcionais (EF) detalhadas para novas funcionalidades, correções e melhorias em sistemas de informação;
  • Atuar como ponte entre negócio e time técnico, garantindo entendimento claro das regras.
  • Apoiar na definição e validação de regras de negócio relacionadas à gestão de ordens de serviço (OS), workforce management (WFM) e integrações com sistemas legados.
  • Acompanhar o ciclo completo das demandas: análise → desenvolvimento → testes → homologação → implantação.

  • Apoiar na análise de incidentes e chamados (Jira), identificando causa raiz e propondo soluções.
  • Documentar processos, fluxos e regras de negócio de forma estruturada e reutilizável.


Conhecimentos específicos:

  • Conceitos de Análise Funcional / Engenharia de Requisitos
  • Familiaridade com elaboração de documentos de Especificação Funcional (EF)
  • Noções de sistemas de gestão operacional / ordens de serviço (OS)
  • Conhecimento básico de integrações entre sistemas (APIs, troca de dados, regras de retorno)
  • Noções de testes funcionais e validação de regras de negócio
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como:
  • Jira (gestão de chamados e backlog) ou outras ferramentas de ITSM
  • Excel (análises básicas)
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação para interação com áreas técnicas e de negócio.


Diferencial:

  • Conhecimento ou experiência com ferramentas de field service
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum / Kanban)
  • Noções de SQL ou consultas para análise de dados
  • Experiência prévia em suporte ou AMS (tratativa de incidentes e melhorias)
  • Conhecimento básico de arquitetura de sistemas (server, mobile e integrações)
  • Capacidade de organizar documentação e estruturar conhecimento (runbooks, fluxos, etc.)

  • Plano de saúde;

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para KOL Business Development Manager (Brazil) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading crypto exchange and Web3 AI company, serving over 40 million users worldwide. Ranked among the top 5 global crypto derivatives platforms and recognized as a pioneer in crypto copy trading, BingX provides a comprehensive suite of AI-driven products and services, including futures, spot trading, copy trading, and TradFi offerings.


BingX empowers users across all experience levels with innovative tools designed to enhance trading performance, confidence, and efficiency. As the principal partner of Chelsea FC since 2024 and the first official crypto exchange partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP in 2026, BingX continues to expand its global presence and strengthen its position as a trusted, intelligent trading platform.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE

  • Formulate business development plans, assist the team in completing the introduction, negotiation, cooperation, and signing of business cooperation projects
  • Contact, negotiate, and close profitable deals with potential Affiliates or KOLs
  • Support Affiliates or KOLs and design special campaigns to increase their trading volume
  • Build partnerships with Affiliates or KOLs and promote cooperation with each other
  • Conduct research to identify new markets and customer needs

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Digital Ad Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere on EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Graphic Designer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

We are…

A digital sports media group with an innovative approach and fan-first mentality, we're redefining how sports content is consumed and shared.

Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. You will collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement creative concepts and ensure brand consistency across all platforms. Daily tasks will include brainstorming ideas, executing design projects, and refining designs based on feedback.

  • Proficiency in Graphic Design and Graphics
  • Experience in Logo Design and Branding
  • Skills in Typography
  • Strong attention to detail and creativity
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Proficiency with design software such as Adobe Creative Suite
  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field
  • Experience in digital media or marketing is a plus
  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written.

title: Head of Compliance (Brazil resident)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance (Brazil resident) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.


Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Head of Compliance on the ground. The authorisation itself depends on having someone the BCB trusts in this seat — someone who treats AML/CFT, KYC, and disclosure as the actual job, not paperwork around it. In your first year, you will have stood up the compliance program the regulator expects to see and built the company's track record with the BCB from zero.


What you'll do

  • Hold statutory officer responsibility for compliance at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Own the design and effectiveness of the AML/CFT and KYC program, including transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and suspicious activity reporting
  • Act as the primary point of contact with the BCB and COAF for compliance matters, including audits, inspections, and ad hoc information requests
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the compliance workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline


What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship, with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing officer or director seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • Direct compliance experience at a BCB-regulated institution (bank, securities broker/distributor, foreign exchange dealer) or at a crypto exchange/VASP
  • Hands-on ownership of AML/CFT and KYC programs, not just oversight of someone else's
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires


Nice-to-have

  • Prior compliance experience specifically within a crypto exchange or VASP
  • AML/compliance certification (e.g. CAMS, ICA)
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB or COAF on audits, inspections, or filings

title: Product Analyst – Vmake · Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Analyst – Vmake · Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Why We Need You

We’re building an AI-powered video creation platform that empowers creators, brands, and e-commerce sellers to produce high-performing content with ease. As our Product Analyst, you’ll combine product thinking, user research, and data-driven insights to help shape features that resonate with Brazilian creators.


You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and the creator community to identify opportunities, validate ideas, and ensure our product solves real user problems. Your understanding of short-form video trends, creator workflows, and AI-powered content creation will directly influence our product roadmap.


What You’ll Do

  • Become a power user of Vmake’s AI video tools by testing new features, identifying usability issues, and evaluating the overall creator experience.
  • Analyze user behavior, creator feedback, and product metrics to uncover opportunities for product improvements.
  • Monitor trends across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, and emerging creator platforms, translating market insights into actionable product recommendations.
  • Partner with Product Managers to define product requirements, prioritize enhancements, and support roadmap planning.
  • Conduct competitive research on AI-powered creative tools and video editing platforms, identifying best practices and product gaps.
  • Gather, organize, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative user feedback into clear product recommendations.
  • Collaborate closely with Design and Engineering teams throughout feature discovery, testing, and iteration.
  • Assist in defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance after launch.
  • Create documentation including product briefs, user stories, competitive analyses, and feature specifications.


Who You Are

  • 3–5 years of experience in Product, Product Analysis, Product Operations, or a related product role within SaaS, AI, creator economy, social media, or e-commerce technology.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian creator ecosystem and short-form video platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and enthusiasm for generative AI technologies.
  • Experience translating customer pain points into clear product requirements.
  • Strong analytical thinking with the ability to interpret both qualitative and quantitative data.
  • Excellent communication skills and experience working cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Engineering.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with changing priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Active content creator with a public portfolio or social media presence.
  • Experience with TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, or creator-focused commerce platforms.
  • Experience conducting user interviews, usability testing, or product discovery.
  • Familiarity with wireframing tools such as Figma.
  • Experience using analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, or similar platforms.

title: Power Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Power Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Transmission Line Engineer - LATAM


Our client is seeking a Transmission Line Engineer to join their growing engineering team. This role will be responsible for supporting the analysis, design, and execution of overhead transmission line projects for utility and energy clients.


The ideal candidate will have experience in transmission line design, power systems, and engineering project delivery, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and contributing to the successful delivery of critical power infrastructure projects.


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform and coordinate transmission line engineering activities for new and existing overhead transmission projects.
  • Complete engineering analysis, calculations, and design work associated with transmission line systems.
  • Provide technical support to internal stakeholders, customers, and project teams.
  • Review project requirements and specifications and recommend design improvements when necessary.
  • Solve complex engineering challenges related to transmission line design and construction.
  • Prepare technical reports, analyses, calculations, and presentations.
  • Perform and oversee transmission line calculations, including:
  • Sag-tension analysis
  • Wire blowout calculations
  • Swing angle analysis
  • Damper recommendations
  • Conductor and wire selection
  • Support multiple projects simultaneously while meeting project schedules and deadlines.
  • Collaborate with engineering, sales, and project management teams to ensure successful project execution.
  • Travel occasionally to customer sites to support project meetings, technical presentations, and project development activities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, preferably with an emphasis in Power Systems.
  • Experience working on utility, transmission, or power infrastructure projects.
  • Familiarity with transmission line design software such as:
  • PLS-CADD
  • SAG10
  • ETAP
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team environment.


What We're Looking For

  • Self-motivated and results-driven professional.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to quality and accuracy.
  • Customer-focused mindset with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Continuous learner with a passion for professional growth and development.
  • Team player who thrives in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.


Apply Today

If you are passionate about power systems, transmission engineering, and delivering innovative solutions for critical infrastructure projects, we would love to hear from you.

title: Contracting Manager, Activities Bank, Travel Industry
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Contracting Manager, Activities Bank, Travel Industry em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Manager – Activities


About Us

At HBX Group , we are a global TravelTech ecosystem connecting and empowering businesses across the world of travel. Through data, innovation, and strong partnerships, we deliver seamless experiences and help our partners grow.

Within our Activities division, we focus on building competitive, high-quality product portfolios that meet evolving market demands. Our teams operate in a fast-paced, data-driven environment where ownership, adaptability, and collaboration are key to success.


Job Summary

As a Contract Manager , you will be responsible for managing and optimizing a portfolio of suppliers, ensuring the product remains competitive, available, and aligned with market needs.

This role combines supplier relationship management, negotiation, reporting, and operational execution , with a strong focus on performance tracking, prioritization, and continuous improvement . You will work closely with internal teams and external partners to drive revenue, maintain product quality, and unlock growth opportunities.


Job Responsibilities

Supplier & Portfolio Management

  • Manage a portfolio of Activities suppliers, ensuring product availability and competitiveness at all times.
  • Maintain and develop strong relationships with suppliers, acting as the main point of contact.
  • Ensure existing products remain optimized and aligned with market expectations.


Contracting & Negotiation

  • Negotiate commercial conditions including rates, inventory, offers, and contract terms.
  • Ensure renewal contracts are competitive and available in time to capture demand.
  • Benchmark competitors and proactively renegotiate where needed to maintain market positioning.


Performance Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze portfolio performance through bi-weekly reports and statistics , identifying trends and opportunities.
  • Monitor KPIs and take actions to improve conversion, revenue, and product performance.
  • Provide insights and explanations on portfolio performance using data and market knowledge.


Operational Excellence

  • Manage multiple processes simultaneously, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and quality.
  • Prioritize tasks effectively based on business impact and deadlines.
  • Maintain updated product content (rates, inclusions, descriptions, availability).
  • Solve operational issues and coordinate solutions with internal teams and suppliers.


Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Sales, Operations, Revenue, Product teams).
  • Support cross-functional initiatives and ensure alignment on commercial priorities.
  • Represent HBX Group in supplier meetings and market visits.


Required Skills

  • Strong prioritization and time management , with the ability to manage multiple processes simultaneously.
  • High level of analytical thinking , comfortable working with reports, data, and performance metrics.
  • Strong commercial mindset with negotiation capabilities.
  • Excellent relationship management and communication skills .
  • High attention to detail and process discipline, with flexibility to manage changing priorities.
  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently.


Required Tech Skills

  • Intermediate Excel skills (data analysis, reporting, tracking KPIs).
  • Experience working with internal systems, contracting tools, or booking platforms .
  • Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actions.
  • Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards is a plus.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 1–3+ years of experience in contracting, sourcing, account management, or similar roles.
  • Experience in travel, tourism, or supplier management is highly preferred.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese for communication with global teams.
  • Availability to travel as part of supplier relationship management.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Senior VIP Relationship Specialist, Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior VIP Relationship Specialist, Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and driven Senior VIP Relationship Specialist to join our VIP team in Brazil. In this senior role, you will serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for our high-value clients in the region. You will be responsible for elevating the customer experience, fostering long-term client loyalty, and leading localized initiatives to drive business success and market share within the Brazilian and broader LATAM crypto ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Portfolio Management & Acquisition: Drive client acquisition and deliver high-touch relationship management for a dedicated portfolio of premium institutional and high-net-worth (HNW) clients in Brazil.
  • Relationship & Engagement: Build strong rapport and trust with existing VIP clients through frequent, personalized, and sustained communication, ensuring high retention and platform loyalty.
  • Process Optimization: Take ownership of designing and optimizing key customer service processes and systems tailored to the local market, establishing management rules, and tracking the life-cycle status of key accounts.
  • Data-Driven Analysis: Analyze client trading behaviors, identify unspoken or sophisticated needs, and prepare comprehensive key customer analysis reports to inform localized product and service strategies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the strategic liaison between Brazil VIP clients and internal stakeholders (Product, Compliance, Operations, and Tech teams) to deliver optimal, seamless, and compliant service solutions.

Qualifications

  • Proven Track Record: A well-established client network in Brazil/LATAM, including institutional clients, high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs), family offices, private banking clients, brokers, or futures institutions.
  • Industry Experience: Direct experience working within crypto trading platforms, digital asset exchanges, or fintech pioneers is highly advantageous.
  • Financial Background: Minimum of 4-6 years of prior experience in sales, account management, or client services within international financial institutions, commercial/private banking, or asset management.
  • Language Proficiency: Native or bilingual fluency in Portuguese (both written and spoken) is mandatory, along with professional proficiency in English for cross-border corporate communication.
  • Adaptability & Resilience: Proven ability to thrive under pressure, manage tight deadlines, and excel in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment.
  • Crypto Passion: Demonstrates a deep enthusiasm for the web3 and cryptocurrency industry, with a sharp understanding of the latest trends, regulatory shifts, and innovations in the Brazilian market.

title: Presales Solution Architect, OSS
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Presales Solution Architect, OSS em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the lead OSS solution architect across the full pre-sales lifecycle – from opportunity qualification and technical discovery through proof-of-concept, proposal, and contract award – partnering closely with Sales leadership to shape, qualify, and grow the regional pipeline.
  • Own and orchestrate end-to-end responses to RFx (RFI / RFP / RFQ), including solution design, compliance and traceability matrices, win themes, technical narratives, effort and Bill-of-Materials estimation, assumptions, and risk identification – driving on-time, high-quality, fully compliant submissions.
  • Design and articulate end-to-end OSS solution architectures spanning Service Assurance, Service Orchestration & Fulfilment, Inventory, and closed-loop automation, mapping the Rakuten Symphony portfolio to operator pain points and measurable business outcomes.
  • Position and demonstrate the Service Assurance portfolio – fault, performance, and service-quality management; AI/ML-driven anomaly detection, alarm correlation and noise reduction; automated root-cause analysis; and predictive, proactive assurance – including customer-experience and network-slice assurance for 5G Standalone.
  • Develop solutions, value cases, and demonstrations around SMO (Service Management & Orchestration) and RIC (RAN Intelligent Controller) platforms, including the Non-RT RIC and rApps (R1, A1 interfaces) and the Near-RT RIC and xApps (E2 interface), addressing use cases such as RAN energy savings, traffic steering, QoE optimization, massive-MIMO and interference management, and anomaly detection.
  • Champion network automation and autonomy – closed-loop operations, intent-based and intent-driven management, and the journey toward TM Forum Level 4 autonomous networks – and translate these capabilities into concrete, quantifiable value propositions for customers.
  • Lead technical proofs-of-concept, lab trials, product demonstrations, and solution integration and validation, tailoring demo environments to each customer’s specific use cases, KPIs, and success criteria.
  • Be responsible and accountable for authoring technical solution documents, high-level designs, design proposals, sizing and Bill-of-Materials, and TCO / ROI models that withstand customer and third-party technical scrutiny.
  • Serve as the trusted technical advisor to customers and prospects – running discovery workshops, executive briefings, and technical deep-dives – and manage technical stakeholder relationships from engineering and operations teams up to C-level.
  • Work cross-functionally with internal teams – Product Management, Engineering, Delivery / Professional Services, Commercial, and Bid Management – and with external parties – operators, system integrators, hyperscalers, and O-RAN / ecosystem partners – to assemble winning and deliverable solutions.
  • Generate thought-leadership content – white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and webinars – and represent Rakuten Symphony at industry events and standards / community forums such as TM Forum and the O-RAN ALLIANCE.
  • Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer conversations and internal strategy.


Requirements:

Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise:

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.
  • Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx responses and customer-facing technical engagements.
  • Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Service Assurance domain – fault, performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management, and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance).
  • Strong working knowledge of network automation and autonomy – closed-loop assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5).
  • Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management interfaces.
  • Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment models.
  • Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines, telemetry, and data lakes).
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate virtual, cross-functional bid and solution teams across multiple geographies and time zones, and to manage internal and external stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel as required.

title: Power Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Power Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Transmission Line Engineer - LATAM


Our client is seeking a Transmission Line Engineer to join their growing engineering team. This role will be responsible for supporting the analysis, design, and execution of overhead transmission line projects for utility and energy clients.


The ideal candidate will have experience in transmission line design, power systems, and engineering project delivery, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and contributing to the successful delivery of critical power infrastructure projects.


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform and coordinate transmission line engineering activities for new and existing overhead transmission projects.
  • Complete engineering analysis, calculations, and design work associated with transmission line systems.
  • Provide technical support to internal stakeholders, customers, and project teams.
  • Review project requirements and specifications and recommend design improvements when necessary.
  • Solve complex engineering challenges related to transmission line design and construction.
  • Prepare technical reports, analyses, calculations, and presentations.
  • Perform and oversee transmission line calculations, including:
  • Sag-tension analysis
  • Wire blowout calculations
  • Swing angle analysis
  • Damper recommendations
  • Conductor and wire selection
  • Support multiple projects simultaneously while meeting project schedules and deadlines.
  • Collaborate with engineering, sales, and project management teams to ensure successful project execution.
  • Travel occasionally to customer sites to support project meetings, technical presentations, and project development activities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, preferably with an emphasis in Power Systems.
  • Experience working on utility, transmission, or power infrastructure projects.
  • Familiarity with transmission line design software such as:
  • PLS-CADD
  • SAG10
  • ETAP
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team environment.


What We're Looking For

  • Self-motivated and results-driven professional.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to quality and accuracy.
  • Customer-focused mindset with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Continuous learner with a passion for professional growth and development.
  • Team player who thrives in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.


Apply Today

If you are passionate about power systems, transmission engineering, and delivering innovative solutions for critical infrastructure projects, we would love to hear from you.

title: Coordenador(a) de Customer Experience
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordenador(a) de Customer Experience em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

COORDENADOR(A) DE CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE | VIVÊNCIA DO ALUNO


Essa posição é para atuar na Ânima Holding , que faz parte do Ecossistema Ânima, o maior e o mais inovador ecossistema de ensino de qualidade do país, com instituições espalhadas por todo o Brasil. Somos uma empresa em constante evolução, que enxerga em cada detalhe novas formas de promover a educação. Por sinal, essa é a essência que nos faz ser diferentes.

Confira mais sobre a nossa oportunidade.

  • Desenvolver estudos, análises e apresentações executivas para apoiar decisões estratégicas;
  • Monitorar tendências e benchmarks de mercado em Customer Experience, propondo soluções inovadoras para evolução contínua da área;
  • Liderar projetos corporativos voltados à melhoria da experiência dos alunos, acompanhando indicadores e resultados das iniciativas implementadas.

  • Domínio em Customer Experience (CX) e Customer Success (CS);
  • Gestão de projetos e metodologias para condução de iniciativas estratégicas;
  • Análise de dados, indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e cultura data-driven;

Pay Rates:

Depending on the client, you may also support order processing, returns management, knowledge base maintenance, or quality assurance initiatives.

  • Must be 21+ years old
  • 1+ years of experience in customer service, customer support, or client-facing roles
  • Bilingual English (C1 or above) / Spanish


Required Skills:


  • Strong understanding of customer service best practices, support workflows, and escalation procedures
  • Experience working with CRM or helpdesk platforms (Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud, LiveAgent, Zoho Desk, or similar)
